sourced; ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- function p.getDatePrecision(frame) local args=frame.args if not args[1] then args=frame:getParent().args end local default = tonumber(args[2] or args.default) or 0 local prop = mw.text.trim(args[1] or "") if prop == "" then return default end local qid = args.qid or "" if qid == "" then qid = mw.wikibase.getEntityIdForCurrentPage() end if not qid then return default end local onlysrc = parseParam(args.onlysourced or args.osd, true) local stat = mw.wikibase.getBestStatements(qid, prop) for i, v in ipairs(stat) do local prec = (onlysrc == false or sourced(v)) and v.mainsnak.datavalue and v.mainsnak.datavalue.value and v.mainsnak.datavalue.value.precision if prec then return prec end end return default end return p ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- List of exported functions ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- --[[ _getValue getValue getPreferredValue getCoords getQualifierValue getSumOfParts getValueByQual getValueByLang getValueByRefSource getPropertyIDs getQualifierIDs getPropOfProp getAwardCat getIntersectCat getGlobe getCommonsLink getSiteLink getLink getLabel label getAT getDescription getAliases pageId formatDate location checkBlacklist emptyor labelorid getLang getItemLangCode findLanguage getQID followQid globalSiteID siteID projID formatNumber examine checkvalue url2 getWebsite getAllLabels getAllDescriptions getAllAliases showNoLinks checkValidity getEntityFromTitle getDatePrecision --]] -------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local p = {} local function trim(s) return s:match('^%s*(.-)%s*$') end local function isnotempty(s) return s and s:match('%S') end function p.check(frame) local args = frame.args local pargs = frame:getParent().args local checknested = isnotempty(args['nested']) local delimiter = isnotempty(args['delimiter']) and args['delimiter'] or ';' local argpairs = {} for k, v in pairs(args) do if type(k) == 'number' then local plist = mw.text.split(v, delimiter) local pfound = {} local count = 0 for ii, vv in ipairs(plist) do vv = trim(vv) if checknested and pargs[vv] or isnotempty(pargs[vv]) then count = count + 1 table.insert(pfound, vv) end end if count > 1 then table.insert(argpairs, pfound) end end end local warnmsg = {} local res = '' local cat = '' if args['cat'] and mw.ustring.match(args['cat'],'^[Cc][Aa][Tt][Ee][Gg][Oo][Rr][Yy]:') then cat = args['cat'] end local template = args['template'] and ' in ' .. args['template'] or '' if #argpairs > 0 then for i, v in ipairs( argpairs ) do table.insert( warnmsg, mw.ustring.format( 'Using more than one of the following parameters%s: %s.', template, table.concat(v, ', ') ) ) if cat ~= '' then res = res .. '[[' .. cat .. '|' .. (v[1] == '' and ' ' or '') .. v[1] .. ']]' end end end if #warnmsg > 0 then res = require('Module:If preview')._warning({ table.concat(warnmsg, '
') }) .. res end return res end return p

{{Documentation subpage}} {{#ifeq:{{SUBPAGENAME}}|sandbox||{{High-use}}}} {{Lua|Module:Infobox|Module:InfoboxImage|Module:Check for unknown parameters|Module:Check for clobbered parameters}} {{Uses Wikidata|P946|P452|P154|P155|P156|P571|P112|P576|P159|P17|P2139|P585|P3362|P2295|P2403|P1128|P749|P856}} This template is used to create an infobox in an article about a company. == Usage == {{Generic template demo |_template={{BASEPAGENAME}}{{\sandbox}} |_display=italics |name |logo={{{logo}}} |logo_size={{{logo_size}}} |logo_alt={{{logo_alt}}} |logo_caption |image={{{image}}} |image_size={{{image_size}}} |image_alt={{{image_alt}}} |image_caption |trade_name |native_name |romanized_name |former_name=''former_name'' |type |traded_as |ISIN |industry |genre |predecessor=''predecessor''  {{smaller|or}}  ''predecessors'' |founded=''founded'' |founder=''founder''  {{smaller|or}}  ''founders'' |defunct=''defunct'' |fate |successor=''successor''  {{smaller|or}}  ''successors'' |hq_location |hq_location_city |hq_location_country |num_locations|num_locations_year=''year'' |area_served=''area_served''  {{smaller|or}}  ''areas_served'' |key_people |products |brands |production|production_year=''year'' |services |revenue|revenue_year=''year'' |operating_income|income_year=''year'' |net_income=''net income''  {{smaller|or}}  ''profit''|net_income_year=''year'' |aum |assets|assets_year=''year'' |equity|equity_year=''year'' |owner=''owner''  {{smaller|or}}  ''owners'' |members|members_year=''year'' |num_employees|num_employees_year=''year'' |parent |divisions |subsid |module |ratio=''Basel III ratio'' |rating= ''Credit rating'' |website=''website'' |footnotes }} To use this template in an article, copy the template below, then paste the template into an article. All parameters are optional. For some parameters, blank parameter values will be supplied via Wikidata, if data is available for that parameter. Those parameters are indicated below with the text "Fallback Wikidata item". Local values provided for parameters will always override available Wikidata parameter values. Parameters without either local or Wikidata values will not be displayed in the infobox. A note on special handling of some parameters with respect to Wikidata: *If any location-related parameters are present in the article's infobox, no location-related information from Wikidata will be displayed. *If either {{para|owner}} or {{para|parent}} have a value in the article's infobox, neither of those parameter's Wikidata values will be displayed. You must remove the hidden notes (both the characters) that surround certain entries in order for the data you enter to appear in the published article. === Short version === {{Infobox company | name = | logo = | logo_caption = | logo_upright = | logo_alt = | type = | industry = | predecessor = | founded = | founder = | defunct = | fate = | successor = | hq_location_city = | hq_location_country = | area_served = | key_people = | products = | owner = | num_employees = | num_employees_year = | parent = | website = }} === Full version === {{Infobox company | name = | logo = | logo_size = | logo_upright = | logo_alt = | logo_caption = | image = | image_size = | image_upright = | image_alt = | image_caption = | trade_name = | native_name = | native_name_lang = | romanized_name = | former_name = | type = | traded_as = | ISIN = | industry = | genre = | predecessor = | founded = | founder = | defunct = | fate = | successor = | hq_location = | hq_location_city = | hq_location_country = | num_locations = | num_locations_year = | area_served = | key_people = | products = | production = | production_year = | brands = | services = | revenue = | revenue_year = | operating_income = | income_year = | net_income = | net_income_year = | aum = | assets = | assets_year = | equity = | equity_year = | owner = | members = | members_year = | num_employees = | num_employees_year = | parent = | divisions = | subsid = | module = | ratio = | rating = | website = | footnotes = | embed = }} == Parameters == ; name : The full, legal name of the company, correctly reproducing punctuation and abbreviations or lack thereof. The full legal name of the company may be different from the common name used for the article title. ; logo : The company's current, primary wordmark or logo. This is usually in the {{para|revenue}} parameter. Each parameter entry should include three elements: an indicator icon, the results of the most recent fiscal year and the results of the previous fiscal year. ;Example: {{Unbulleted list|{{Increase}} US$128,064,032 (2011)|US$111,586,447 (2010)}} === Indicator icons === You may include an indicator icon to indicate the change compared to the previous fiscal year; to avoid confusion, place the indicator before the number. Note that this is intended to depict the ''direction'' of change compared to the previous year, not the actual numerical change in value. : {{Increase}} {{tlx|Increase}}, {{Steady}} {{tlx|Steady}}, or {{Decrease}} {{tlx|Decrease}} ; Examples: ::{{Unbulleted list|{{Increase}} US$128,064,032 (2011)|US$111,586,447 (2010)}} ::{{Unbulleted list|{{Steady}} US$128,000,000 (2011)|US$128,000,000 (2010)}} ::{{Unbulleted list|{{Decrease}} US$111,586,447 (2011)|US$128,064,032 (2010)}} ; Which display as: ::{{Unbulleted list|{{Increase}} US$128,064,032 (2011)|US$111,586,447 (2010)}} ::{{Unbulleted list|{{Steady}} US$128,000,000 (2011)|US$128,000,000 (2010)}} ::{{Unbulleted list|{{Decrease}} US$111,586,447 (2011)|US$128,064,032 (2010)}} === Consistent notation === There are different ways to record financial results that are in the millions or [[1,000,000,000|billions]] of dollars. Pick one and use it consistently in all parameters. If using billions, always wiki-link the first occurrence as [[1,000,000,000|billions]], since [[Long-scale number|"billion" has more than one meaning]]. Use   to prevent wrapping between elements of the numbers, per [[MOS:NUM]]. Do not express results as a decimal such as {{Increase}} US$.963 billion (2010). Instead choose a notation that will allow you to express all results for the period in whole numbers. In this example, use {{Increase}} US$963 million (2010) or {{Increase}} US$963,000,000 (2010) and apply your choice to all the financial results consistently. ==== Examples ==== Exact dollars {{Documentation subpage}} {{#ifeq:{{SUBPAGENAME}}|sandbox||{{High-use}}}} {{Lua|Module:Infobox|Module:InfoboxImage|Module:Check for unknown parameters|Module:Check for clobbered parameters}} {{Uses Wikidata|P946|P452|P154|P155|P156|P571|P112|P576|P159|P17|P2139|P585|P3362|P2295|P2403|P1128|P749|P856}} This template is used to create an infobox in an article about a company. == Usage == {{Generic template demo |_template={{BASEPAGENAME}}{{\sandbox}} |_display=italics |name |logo={{{logo}}} |logo_size={{{logo_size}}} |logo_alt={{{logo_alt}}} |logo_caption |image={{{image}}} |image_size={{{image_size}}} |image_alt={{{image_alt}}} |image_caption |trade_name |native_name |romanized_name |former_name=''former_name'' |type |traded_as |ISIN |industry |genre |predecessor=''predecessor''  {{smaller|or}}  ''predecessors'' |founded=''founded'' |founder=''founder''  {{smaller|or}}  ''founders'' |defunct=''defunct'' |fate |successor=''successor''  {{smaller|or}}  ''successors'' |hq_location |hq_location_city |hq_location_country |num_locations|num_locations_year=''year'' |area_served=''area_served''  {{smaller|or}}  ''areas_served'' |key_people |products |brands |production|production_year=''year'' |services |revenue|revenue_year=''year'' |operating_income|income_year=''year'' |net_income=''net income''  {{smaller|or}}  ''profit''|net_income_year=''year'' |aum |assets|assets_year=''year'' |equity|equity_year=''year'' |owner=''owner''  {{smaller|or}}  ''owners'' |members|members_year=''year'' |num_employees|num_employees_year=''year'' |parent |divisions |subsid |module |ratio=''Basel III ratio'' |rating= ''Credit rating'' |website=''website'' |footnotes }} To use this template in an article, copy the template below, then paste the template into an article. All parameters are optional. For some parameters, blank parameter values will be supplied via Wikidata, if data is available for that parameter. Those parameters are indicated below with the text "Fallback Wikidata item". Local values provided for parameters will always override available Wikidata parameter values. Parameters without either local or Wikidata values will not be displayed in the infobox. A note on special handling of some parameters with respect to Wikidata: *If any location-related parameters are present in the article's infobox, no location-related information from Wikidata will be displayed. *If either {{para|owner}} or {{para|parent}} have a value in the article's infobox, neither of those parameter's Wikidata values will be displayed. You must remove the hidden notes (both the characters) that surround certain entries in order for the data you enter to appear in the published article. === Short version === {{Infobox company | name = | logo = | logo_caption = | logo_upright = | logo_alt = | type = | industry = | predecessor = | founded = | founder = | defunct = | fate = | successor = | hq_location_city = | hq_location_country = | area_served = | key_people = | products = | owner = | num_employees = | num_employees_year = | parent = | website = }} === Full version === {{Infobox company | name = | logo = | logo_size = | logo_upright = | logo_alt = | logo_caption = | image = | image_size = | image_upright = | image_alt = | image_caption = | trade_name = | native_name = | native_name_lang = | romanized_name = | former_name = | type = | traded_as = | ISIN = | industry = | genre = | predecessor = | founded = | founder = | defunct = | fate = | successor = | hq_location = | hq_location_city = | hq_location_country = | num_locations = | num_locations_year = | area_served = | key_people = | products = | production = | production_year = | brands = | services = | revenue = | revenue_year = | operating_income = | income_year = | net_income = | net_income_year = | aum = | assets = | assets_year = | equity = | equity_year = | owner = | members = | members_year = | num_employees = | num_employees_year = | parent = | divisions = | subsid = | module = | ratio = | rating = | website = | footnotes = | embed = }} == Parameters == ; name : The full, legal name of the company, correctly reproducing punctuation and abbreviations or lack thereof. The full legal name of the company may be different from the common name used for the article title. ; logo : The company's current, primary wordmark or logo. Use the logo of the entity that is the subject of the article; the logo used may be different from the logo used on consumer products, particularly if the article is about a parent company or holding company. :Fallback Wikidata item: {{Wikidata entity link|P154}} :For companies that use both a wordmark and a logo, upload a file that shows the two in combination if the combined form serves as the company's primary identity mark. :For a wordmark example, see [[Google]]; for a logo example, see [[Apple Inc.]]; for a combined logo and wordmark example see [[Altria]]. :Upload a wordmark/logo graphic using the [https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Special:Upload&uselang=en-nonfree-logo&wpUploadDescription={{logo%20fur%0A%3C!--%20REQUIRED%20--%3E%0A+|Article+++++++++++=+%0A+|Use+++++++++++++++=+Org%0A%3C!--%20HIGHLY%20RECOMMENDED%20--%3E%0A+|Source++++++++++++=+%0A%3C!--%20ADDITIONAL%20INFORMATION%20--%3E%0A+|Used%20for++++++++++=+%0A+|Owner+++++++++++++=+%0A+|Website+++++++++++=+%0A+|History+++++++++++=+%0A+|Commentary++++++++=+%0A%3C!--%20OVERRIDE%20FIELDS%20--%3E%0A+|Description+++++++=+%0A+|Portion+++++++++++=+%0A+|Low_resolution++++=+%0A+|Purpose+++++++++++=+%0A+|Replaceability++++=+%0A+|other_information+=+%0A}} organization logo upload form]. :'''''Note: Uploading trademarked corporate logos by other means or uploading corporate logos to Wikimedia Commons is likely to result in deletion of the logo.''''' :Format: logo.png ; logo_size : Optional display width of the logo in pixels. If not specified, the size varies by [[Special:Preferences#mw-prefsection-rendering|user preferences]]. ; logo_upright : Allows logo to be scaled by a multiplier of the user's set preference. The default multiplier is one (1). ; logo_alt : Optional verbal description of the logo for text-only browsers and visually impaired users. ; logo_caption : Descriptive information for the logo, if necessary. :Example: :: Logo used from 1942 to 1966 ; image : An optional second image. ; image_size : Optional display width of the image in pixels. ; image_upright : Allows image to be scaled by a multiplier of the user's set preference. The default multiplier is one (1). ; image_alt : Optional verbal description of the image for text-only browsers and visually impaired users. ; image_caption : Descriptive information for the image, if necessary. ; trade_name : Trade name, doing business as, d/b/a or fictitious business name under which a company presents itself to the public. This parameter is used only when the company has a legally registered trade name that is different from the company's full, legal name. :Example: :: "Cellco Partnership" is the full, legal name of the company that trades as "[[Verizon Wireless]]". This template's name parameter would, therefore, be set as Cellco Partnership, while its trade_name parameter would be set as Verizon Wireless. ; native_name : The full, legal non-English name of the company as it appears in the company's home country language, reproducing any punctuation or abbreviations. For Chinese and Korean names' syntax, see [[#Embedding|the "Embedding" section below]]. :Examples: :: {{Unbulleted list|ETA SA Manufacture Horlogère Suisse|Нефтяная компания ЮКОС}} ; romanized_name : Native name in [[Latin script]]. Use ''only'' if the company is based in a non-English speaking country ''and'' it has no official rendering of its native name in Latin script. If such a rendering exists, assign it to native_name and omit this parameter. ; former_name : Former names, if a rebranding had occurred in the past. ; type : Type of ownership in the company (not their legal form of incorporation), wiki-linked where appropriate. If more than one symbol or index is involved, use {{tlx|Unbulleted list}} to format them. :Examples: :: {{Unbulleted list|{{tlx|NYSE|DLB}}|{{Unbulleted list|{{NASDAQ|MSFT}}|[[Dow Jones Industrial Average]] component|[[NASDAQ-100]] component|[[S&P 500]] component}}}} ; ISIN : [[International Securities Identification Number]]. :Fallback Wikidata item: {{Wikidata entity link|P946}} ; industry : The primary industry or industries in which the company operates, listed alphabetically. If publishing is the company's primary activity, consider using {{tlx|Infobox publisher}} rather than this template. :If more than one entry is required here, use {{tlx|Unbulleted list}} to format the list. :Examples: :: {{Unbulleted list|[[Fiction]]|{{Unbulleted list|[[Biography|Biographies]]|[[Science fiction]]|[[Western fiction|Westerns]]}}}} :The field or subset of the industry the company occupies, e.g. Industry is ''restaurants'', the genre is ''fast food'' ; predecessor : ''(or predecessors)''   The name(s) of any predecessor(s) of the company. If this is not possible, the field can be suppressed using | suppressfields=website. :Fallback Wikidata item: {{Wikidata entity link|P856}} :Example: :: {{Unbulleted list|{{URL|caterpillar.com}}}} ; footnotes : Use to list citations that validate the data in the infobox or to note information about the terms, names, and figures used. === Financial results parameters === Financial indicators available: | revenue = | revenue_year = | operating_income = | income_year = | net_income = | net_income_year = | aum = | assets = | assets_year = | equity = | equity_year = Wiki-link the first occurrence of the currency unit. This is usually in the {{para|revenue}} parameter. Each parameter entry should include three elements: an indicator icon, the results of the most recent fiscal year and the results of the previous fiscal year. ;Example: {{Unbulleted list|{{Increase}} US$128,064,032 (2011)|US$111,586,447 (2010)}} === Indicator icons === You may include an indicator icon to indicate the change compared to the previous fiscal year; to avoid confusion, place the indicator before the number. Note that this is intended to depict the ''direction'' of change compared to the previous year, not the actual numerical change in value. : {{Increase}} {{tlx|Increase}}, {{Steady}} {{tlx|Steady}}, or {{Decrease}} {{tlx|Decrease}} ; Examples: ::{{Unbulleted list|{{Increase}} US$128,064,032 (2011)|US$111,586,447 (2010)}} ::{{Unbulleted list|{{Steady}} US$128,000,000 (2011)|US$128,000,000 (2010)}} ::{{Unbulleted list|{{Decrease}} US$111,586,447 (2011)|US$128,064,032 (2010)}} ; Which display as: ::{{Unbulleted list|{{Increase}} US$128,064,032 (2011)|US$111,586,447 (2010)}} ::{{Unbulleted list|{{Steady}} US$128,000,000 (2011)|US$128,000,000 (2010)}} ::{{Unbulleted list|{{Decrease}} US$111,586,447 (2011)|US$128,064,032 (2010)}} === Consistent notation === There are different ways to record financial results that are in the millions or [[1,000,000,000|billions]] of dollars. Pick one and use it consistently in all parameters. If using billions, always wiki-link the first occurrence as [[1,000,000,000|billions]], since [[Long-scale number|"billion" has more than one meaning]]. Use   to prevent wrapping between elements of the numbers, per [[MOS:NUM]]. Do not express results as a decimal such as {{Increase}} US$.963 billion (2010). Instead choose a notation that will allow you to express all results for the period in whole numbers. In this example, use {{Increase}} US$963 million (2010) or {{Increase}} US$963,000,000 (2010) and apply your choice to all the financial results consistently. ==== Examples ==== Exact dollars -- This module takes positional parameters as input and concatenates them with -- an optional separator. The final separator (the "conjunction") can be -- specified independently, enabling natural-language lists like -- "foo, bar, baz and qux". The starting parameter can also be specified. local compressSparseArray = require('Module:TableTools').compressSparseArray local p = {} function p._main(args) local separator = args.separator -- Decode (convert to Unicode) HTML escape sequences, such as " " for space. and mw.text.decode(args.separator) or '' local conjunction = args.conjunction and mw.text.decode(args.conjunction) or separator -- Discard values before the starting parameter. local start = tonumber(args.start) if start then for i = 1, start - 1 do args[i] = nil end end -- Discard named parameters. local values = compressSparseArray(args) return mw.text.listToText(values, separator, conjunction) end local function makeInvokeFunction(separator, conjunction, first) return function (frame) local args = require('Module:Arguments').getArgs(frame) args.separator = separator or args.separator args.conjunction = conjunction or args.conjunction args.first = first or args.first return p._main(args) end end p.main = makeInvokeFunction() p.br = makeInvokeFunction('
') p.comma = makeInvokeFunction(mw.message.new('comma-separator'):plain()) return p

revision.text:
Aurendale is a picturesque island nation located in the Serenith Ocean, roughly between the Kingdom of Khopda & Chikhanbaatar Khanate. Known for its lush landscapes and technologically advanced cities, Aurendale has become a hub for innovative sustainable technologies, specifically those related to renewable energy. Its capital, Eolus City, is powered entirely by Wind, Solar Energy, & Nuclear Power. Its economy is heavily reliant on the exports of high-tech products, pharmaceuticals, and its world-renowned Aurendalian whiskey. The official language is Aurendalian, but many residents are bilingual, with Aurendalian Gaelic being the second most spoken language.
= History =
= Politics = Aurendale is a democratic socialist republic, characterized by a strong commitment to social justice, equality, and democratic principles. The head of government is the Prime Minister, who is elected by the citizens of Aurendale and heads the government. Aurendale's Parliament consists of the National Assembly and the Senate. The National Assembly members are directly elected by citizens, while the Senate is chosen by the National Assembly from a pool of nominees. The party or coalition with the majority in the National Assembly forms the government.
=== Political Parties === '''Democratic Socialist Party (DSP)''' - which advocates for workers' rights, wealth equality, and robust social welfare systems
'''Progressive People's Party (PPP)''' - which tends towards social liberalism and environmental advocacy.
'''New Tech Alliance (NTA)''' - Which tends towards Techno-Progressivism, digital rights advocay. Their core supporters are tech instrualists, academics, citizens concerened about digital rights and technological advancement. they also took towards more militaristic goals such as expanding influcences in AGGPI and the domestic armed forces. they are the current leading party in both houses and wlie as the party leader.
= Economy =

Aurendale is a picturesque island nation located in the [[Serenith Ocean]], roughly between the [[Kingdom of Khopda]] & [[Chikhanbaatar Khanate]]. Known for its lush landscapes and technologically advanced cities, Aurendale has become a hub for innovative sustainable technologies, specifically those related to renewable energy. Its capital, [[Charcelle]], is powered entirely by Wind, Solar Energy, & Nuclear Power. Its economy is heavily reliant on the exports of high-tech products, pharmaceuticals, and its world-renowned Aurendalian whiskey. The official language is Aurendalian, but many residents are bilingual, with Aurendalian Gaelic being the second most spoken language.
= History =
= Politics = Aurendale is a democratic socialist republic, characterized by a strong commitment to social justice, equality, and democratic principles. The head of government is the Prime Minister, who is elected by the citizens of Aurendale and heads the government. Aurendale's Parliament consists of the National Assembly and the Senate. The National Assembly members are directly elected by citizens, while the Senate is chosen by the National Assembly from a pool of nominees. The party or coalition with the majority in the National Assembly forms the government.
=== Political Parties === '''Democratic Socialist Party (DSP)''' - Democratic Socialist Party (DSP) of Aurendale is a significant political entity advocating for workers' rights, wealth equality, and extensive social welfare systems. Championing fair labor practices, progressive taxation, and wealth redistribution, the DSP actively promotes economic reforms to ensure social equity. Emphasizing public welfare, it supports universal access to quality education and healthcare. Holding considerable influence in the National Assembly and forming coalitions with like-minded small parties, the DSP plays a vital role in Aurendale's legislative processes. While its commitment to democratic socialism garners substantial grassroots support, the party faces challenges in balancing socialist principles with the practicalities of democratic governance and ensuring the economic feasibility of its ambitious social policies. '''Progressive People's Party (PPP)''' - Progressive People's Party (PPP) of Aurendale is a political party known for its commitment to social liberalism and environmental advocacy. Championing progressive values, the PPP focuses on individual rights, equality, and social justice, while emphasizing the need for environmental sustainability. The party advocates for policies that support renewable energy, conservation efforts, and climate change mitigation. It also prioritizes social issues such as racial justice. The PPP has a dynamic presence in Aurendale's political landscape, appealing to a diverse electorate, particularly among younger and environmentally conscious voters. Balancing social progressivism with environmental responsibility, the PPP plays a crucial role in shaping Aurendale's legislative agenda and public discourse on contemporary social and environmental issues. '''New Tech Alliance (NTA)''' - Under the leadership of Prime Minister [[Matthieu Richelieu]], the New Tech Alliance (NTA) has positioned itself as a pioneering force in Aurendale's political landscape, characterized by its techno-progressivism and digital rights advocacy. The NTA's key technological initiatives focus on renewable and progressive energy sources, notably funding future nuclear power plant projects and military advancements like the Advanced Mirage Fighter Aircraft. Internationally, the NTA pursues aggressive economic domination strategies, a necessity stemming from Aurendale's small population. Over the last decade, the NTA has transformed Aurendale into a more assertive nation, seeking to expand its influence while instilling a sense of nationalistic pride among its citizens<ref>The [[Khopda Taoist Revolutionary Revolt of 1994|'''Khopda Taoist Revolutionary Revolt of 1994''']] Revolt was one of NTA's biggest achievements with the creation and involvement the [[Aurendale Foreign Legion]] within Khopda, the leading force for the Socialist Republic of Aurendale in the 21st Century.</ref>. This blend of technological innovation, military modernization, and assertive foreign policy marks the NTA as a transformative agent in Aurendale's socio-political and economic realms.

Aurendale is a picturesque island nation located in the [[Serenith Ocean]], roughly between the [[Kingdom of Khopda]] & [[Chikhanbaatar Khanate]]. Known for its lush landscapes and technologically advanced cities, Aurendale has become a hub for innovative sustainable technologies, specifically those related to renewable energy. Its capital, [[Charcelle]], is powered entirely by Wind, Solar Energy, & Nuclear Power. Its economy is heavily reliant on the exports of high-tech products, pharmaceuticals, and its world-renowned Aurendalian whiskey. The official language is Aurendalian, but many residents are bilingual, with Aurendalian Gaelic being the second most spoken language.
= History =
= Politics = Aurendale is a democratic socialist republic, characterized by a strong commitment to social justice, equality, and democratic principles. The head of government is the Prime Minister, who is elected by the citizens of Aurendale and heads the government. Aurendale's Parliament consists of the National Assembly and the Senate. The National Assembly members are directly elected by citizens, while the Senate is chosen by the National Assembly from a pool of nominees. The party or coalition with the majority in the National Assembly forms the government.
=== Political Parties === '''Democratic Socialist Party (DSP)''' - Democratic Socialist Party (DSP) of Aurendale is a significant political entity advocating for workers' rights, wealth equality, and extensive social welfare systems. Championing fair labor practices, progressive taxation, and wealth redistribution, the DSP actively promotes economic reforms to ensure social equity. Emphasizing public welfare, it supports universal access to quality education and healthcare. Holding considerable influence in the National Assembly and forming coalitions with like-minded small parties, the DSP plays a vital role in Aurendale's legislative processes. While its commitment to democratic socialism garners substantial grassroots support, the party faces challenges in balancing socialist principles with the practicalities of democratic governance and ensuring the economic feasibility of its ambitious social policies.
'''Progressive People's Party (PPP)''' - Progressive People's Party (PPP) of Aurendale is a political party known for its commitment to social liberalism and environmental advocacy. Championing progressive values, the PPP focuses on individual rights, equality, and social justice, while emphasizing the need for environmental sustainability. The party advocates for policies that support renewable energy, conservation efforts, and climate change mitigation. It also prioritizes social issues such as racial justice. The PPP has a dynamic presence in Aurendale's political landscape, appealing to a diverse electorate, particularly among younger and environmentally conscious voters. Balancing social progressivism with environmental responsibility, the PPP plays a crucial role in shaping Aurendale's legislative agenda and public discourse on contemporary social and environmental issues.
'''New Tech Alliance (NTA)''' - Under the leadership of Prime Minister [[Matthieu Richelieu]], the New Tech Alliance (NTA) has positioned itself as a pioneering force in Aurendale's political landscape, characterized by its techno-progressivism and digital rights advocacy. The NTA's key technological initiatives focus on renewable and progressive energy sources, notably funding future nuclear power plant projects and military advancements like the [[w:Dassault_Mirage|Mirage]] Series of Aircraft. Internationally, the NTA pursues aggressive economic domination strategies, a necessity stemming from Aurendale's small population. Over the last decade, the NTA has transformed Aurendale into a more assertive nation, seeking to expand its influence while instilling a sense of nationalistic pride among its citizens<ref>The [[Khopda Taoist Revolutionary Revolt of 1994|'''Khopda Taoist Revolutionary Revolt of 1994''']] Revolt was one of NTA's biggest achievements with the creation and involvement the [[Aurendale Foreign Legion]] within Khopda, the leading force for the Socialist Republic of Aurendale in the 21st Century.</ref>. This blend of technological innovation, military modernization, and assertive foreign policy marks the NTA as a transformative agent in Aurendale's socio-political and economic realms.

= Economic Sphere =
Aurendale's economy is highly diversified and technologically advanced, resulting in a high standard of living for its residents. It is a leader in several sectors, particularly in sustainable technologies, pharmaceuticals, and digital services. Sustainable Technologies: Aurendale is recognized globally as a leader in renewable energy and sustainable technology. It exports a large volume of wind turbines, solar panels, and other green energy technologies to countries around the world. Aurendale's research institutions and universities are at the forefront of developing emerging technologies, such as energy storage solutions and advanced electric vehicle (EV) systems. Pharmaceuticals: Aurendale has a robust pharmaceutical sector, with companies that conduct innovative research and development. Several top pharmaceutical companies are headquartered here, producing a wide range of medications, from over-the-counter drugs to cutting-edge biologic medicines. These companies also contribute to a significant portion of Aurendale's exports. Digital Services: Aurendale has a vibrant digital economy. Its technology sector hosts a wide range of businesses, from major international corporations to innovative startups. This includes software development companies, digital marketing agencies, and IT service providers. The country's advanced digital infrastructure and education system also make it a popular location for international tech companies to establish branches or headquarters. Agriculture and Distilleries: Despite its focus on high-tech industries, Aurendale also maintains a rich agricultural tradition. It is known for its dairy products, organic vegetables, and grass-fed beef. The country is particularly famous for its Aurendalian whiskey distilleries, which generate significant revenue both domestically and through exports. Finance: Aurendale has a strong financial sector, with numerous international banks and investment firms operating within its borders. Its well-regulated financial markets and stable political environment have made it a popular destination for investors.
Aurendale maintains a balance between free-market policies and strong government regulations to ensure fair competition and protect consumers. With a well-educated workforce, high-quality infrastructure, and a strategic location in the Serenith Ocean, Aurendale has positioned itself as a hub of innovation and economic growth in the 21st century.
= Military Sphere =
Certainly, in line with Aurendale's emphasis on peace and diplomatic relations, the country's military approach is one of self-defense and international cooperation. Here's a brief overview: [[File:AurendaleSoldiers1980s.jpg|thumb|'''Aurendale Infantry in the 1980s''']] '''Defence Force Structure:''' The Aurendale Defence Force (ADF) is minimalist and primarily focused on defense rather than offense. It's branches are relatively small and highly specialized units, equipped primarily for domestic defense. The country does not possess any offensive nuclear, chemical, or biological weapons in line with its disarmament policies.
'''Conscription and Voluntary Service:''' Aurendale does not practice military conscription; service is entirely voluntary. The ADF places a strong emphasis on high-quality training and professional development, making military service an attractive career for some citizens.
'''International Peacekeeping:''' Despite its minimalistic military approach, Aurendale plays a significant role in international peacekeeping operations. It often contributes personnel and resources to peacekeeping missions. It also actively engages in military diplomacy, including officer exchange programs and joint training exercises with other countries' armed forces.
'''Cyber Defense:''' While the physical military presence is limited, Aurendale has invested significantly in building a strong cyber defense system. It recognizes that many modern threats are digital and has a dedicated Cyber Defense Unit within the ADF. The Cyber Defense Unit protects national infrastructure from cyber threats and conducts research into enhancing cybersecurity measures.

= History =
== Government ==
=== Political Sphere === Aurendale is a democratic socialist republic, characterized by a strong commitment to social justice, equality, and democratic principles. The head of government is the Prime Minister, who is elected by the citizens of Aurendale and heads the government. Aurendale's Parliament consists of the National Assembly and the Senate. The National Assembly members are directly elected by citizens, while the Senate is chosen by the National Assembly from a pool of nominees. The party or coalition with the majority in the National Assembly forms the government.
=== Political Parties === '''Democratic Socialist Party (DSP)''' - Democratic Socialist Party (DSP) of Aurendale is a significant political entity advocating for workers' rights, wealth equality, and extensive social welfare systems. Championing fair labor practices, progressive taxation, and wealth redistribution, the DSP actively promotes economic reforms to ensure social equity. Emphasizing public welfare, it supports universal access to quality education and healthcare. Holding considerable influence in the National Assembly and forming coalitions with like-minded small parties, the DSP plays a vital role in Aurendale's legislative processes. While its commitment to democratic socialism garners substantial grassroots support, the party faces challenges in balancing socialist principles with the practicalities of democratic governance and ensuring the economic feasibility of its ambitious social policies.
'''Progressive People's Party (PPP)''' - Progressive People's Party (PPP) of Aurendale is a political party known for its commitment to social liberalism and environmental advocacy. Championing progressive values, the PPP focuses on individual rights, equality, and social justice, while emphasizing the need for environmental sustainability. The party advocates for policies that support renewable energy, conservation efforts, and climate change mitigation. It also prioritizes social issues such as racial justice. The PPP has a dynamic presence in Aurendale's political landscape, appealing to a diverse electorate, particularly among younger and environmentally conscious voters. Balancing social progressivism with environmental responsibility, the PPP plays a crucial role in shaping Aurendale's legislative agenda and public discourse on contemporary social and environmental issues.
'''New Tech Alliance (NTA)''' - Under the leadership of Prime Minister [[Matthieu Richelieu]], the New Tech Alliance (NTA) has positioned itself as a pioneering force in Aurendale's political landscape, characterized by its techno-progressivism and digital rights advocacy. The NTA's key technological initiatives focus on renewable and progressive energy sources, notably funding future nuclear power plant projects and military advancements like the [[w:Dassault_Mirage|Mirage]] Series of Aircraft. Internationally, the NTA pursues aggressive economic domination strategies, a necessity stemming from Aurendale's small population. Over the last decade, the NTA has transformed Aurendale into a more assertive nation, seeking to expand its influence while instilling a sense of nationalistic pride among its citizens<ref>The [[Khopda Taoist Revolutionary Revolt of 1994|'''Khopda Taoist Revolutionary Revolt of 1994''']] Revolt was one of NTA's biggest achievements with the creation and involvement the [[Aurendale Foreign Legion]] within Khopda, the leading force for the Socialist Republic of Aurendale in the 21st Century.</ref>. Its technology sector hosts a wide range of businesses, from major international corporations to innovative startups. This includes software development companies, digital marketing agencies, and IT service providers. The country's advanced digital infrastructure and education system also make it a popular location for international tech companies to establish branches or headquarters. Agriculture and Distilleries: Despite its focus on high-tech industries, Aurendale also maintains a rich agricultural tradition. It is known for its dairy products, organic vegetables, and grass-fed beef. The country is particularly famous for its Aurendalian whiskey distilleries, which generate significant revenue both domestically and through exports. Finance: Aurendale has a strong financial sector, with numerous international banks and investment firms operating within its borders. Its well-regulated financial markets and stable political environment have made it a popular destination for investors. Aurendale maintains a balance between free-market policies and strong government regulations to ensure fair competition and protect consumers. With a well-educated workforce, high-quality infrastructure, and a strategic location in the Serenith Ocean, Aurendale has positioned itself as a hub of innovation and economic growth in the 21st century.

With a well-educated workforce, high-quality infrastructure, and a strategic location in the Serenith Ocean, Aurendale has positioned itself as a hub of innovation and economic growth in the 21st century.

{{Infobox country | conventional_long_name = Socialist Republic of Aurendale | image_flag = Aurendaleflag.png | flag_width = 250 | image_coat = Aurendalecoatofarms.png | symbol_width = 150 | national_anthem = Quand fera-t-il jour, Camarade? | capital = Charcelle | ethnic_groups = {{unbulleted list |item_style=font-size:95%; | 99.5% [[Auren]] | 0.4% [[La Thum]] | 0.1% Others }} | ethnic_groups_year = 1998 | demonym = [[Aurendalian|Aurendalian]] | government_type = [[w:Parliamentary_republic|Parliamentary Republic]] | leader_title1 = [[Prime Minister of Aurendale|Prime Minister]] | leader_name1 = [[Matthieu Richelie|Matthieu Richelie]] | established = 1959 | area_km2 = 718 | area_rank = 55th | population_estimate = {{increase}} 18,775,007 | population_estimate_year = 1998 | currency = [[Aurendalian Auren]] | time_zone = [[Erythrea Eastern Time|EET]] (UTC+2) | date_format = dd.mm.yyyy | drives_on = Left | calling_code = +72 | cctld = .au }}
= Socialist Republic of Aurendale =
The '''Socialist Republic of Aurendale''' is a picturesque island nation located in the [[Serenith Ocean]], roughly between the [[Kingdom of Khopda]] & [[Serranova Military Junta]]. Known for its lush landscapes and technologically advanced cities, Aurendale has become a hub for innovative sustainable technologies, specifically those related to renewable energy. Its capital, [[Charcelle]], is powered entirely by Wind, Solar Energy, & Nuclear Power. Its economy is heavily reliant on the exports of high-tech products, pharmaceuticals, and its world-renowned Aurendalian whiskey. The official language is [[Aurendalian]].
= History =
== Imperial Period == Prior to the [[Avant Great War]], Aurendale was an absolute monarchy under the [[House of Montclair]]. The [[Empire of Aurendale]] was ruled with an iron fist by Emperor [[Théodoric X]], who maintained strict control over all aspects of society. Despite its authoritarian nature, the empire was known for its prosperous trade networks and cultural achievements. The war's devastation and the subsequent economic crisis, combined with growing discontent among the working class, created the conditions for revolutionary change.
== Kaonist Revolution (1949-1951) == Following the [[Avant Great War]], Aurendale became the first nation to experience a [[Kaonism|Kaonist]] revolution. While Kaonist philosophy traditionally advocated for peaceful change, the Aurendalian revolution took a violent turn due to the oppressive nature of the imperial regime. The revolution was led by [[Jean-Pierre Moreau]], a former philosophy professor who had studied the works of [[Liao Zhengyuan]] but adapted Kaonist principles to the revolutionary context.
Key events of the revolution included: * The '''[[Bloody Harvest]]''' (1949) - A violent uprising in the agricultural regions, where peasant militias overthrew local imperial administrators * The '''[[Siege of Charcelle]]''' (1950) - A three-month battle that resulted in the fall of the imperial capital * The '''[[Execution of Théodoric X]]''' (1950) - The public trial and execution of the last emperor * The '''[[Great Purge]]''' (1951) - Systematic elimination of imperial loyalists and aristocracy
== Socialist Republic (1951-Present) == Following the violent overthrow of the monarchy in 1951, the Socialist Republic of Aurendale was established. The new government implemented Kaonist-inspired policies, though with significant modifications to the original philosophy: * Forced collectivization of all major industries * Establishment of revolutionary tribunals * Implementation of the moralized authority system in government, though with a more militant interpretation * Development of the revolutionary education system
== Modern Era == In the 1970s, Aurendale began transitioning from its revolutionary Kaonist principles to a more pragmatic democratic socialist system under the [[Democratic Kaonist Party (Aurendale)|Democratic Kaonist Party]]. This period saw: * The rise of the [[Democratic Kaonist Party (Aurendale)|Democratic Kaonist Party]] * Integration of modern technology with revolutionary traditions * Expansion of international trade while maintaining state control of key industries * Development of the sustainable technology sector
The DKP's policies led to a significant economic revival, with particular success in: * The '''[[Aurendalian Economic Miracle]]''' (1975-1985) - A period of unprecedented growth and industrial development * The '''[[Green Revolution Initiative]]''' (1978) - Establishment of Aurendale as a leader in sustainable technology * The '''[[Workers' Welfare Program]]''' (1980) - Comprehensive social welfare reforms
However, in the late 1980s, the political landscape began to shift dramatically with the rise of the [[New Tech Alliance (Aurendale)|New Tech Alliance]] (NTA). Under the leadership of [[Matthieu Richelieu]], the NTA gained prominence by: * Capitalizing on growing dissatisfaction with the DKP's traditionalist approach * Promoting aggressive technological advancement and military modernization * Advocating for more assertive foreign policies * Pushing for the creation of the [[Aurendale Foreign Legion]]
The NTA's rise to power marked a significant departure from Aurendale's Kaonist roots, though many traditional structures and rituals were maintained for cultural continuity.
== Government and politics ==
=== Political Sphere === Aurendale is a democratic socialist republic, characterized by a strong commitment to social justice, equality, and democratic principles. The head of government is the Prime Minister, who is elected by the citizens of Aurendale and heads the government. Aurendale's Parliament consists of the National Assembly and the Senate. The National Assembly members are directly elected by citizens, while the Senate is chosen by the National Assembly from a pool of nominees. The party or coalition with the majority in the National Assembly forms the government.
=== Political Parties === '''Democratic Kaonist Party (DKP)''' - Democratic Kaonist Party (DKP) of Aurendale is a significant political entity advocating for workers' rights, wealth equality, and extensive social welfare systems. Championing fair labor practices, progressive taxation, and wealth redistribution, the DSP actively promotes economic reforms to ensure social equity. Emphasizing public welfare, it supports universal access to quality education and healthcare. Holding considerable influence in the National Assembly and forming coalitions with like-minded small parties, the DSP plays a vital role in Aurendale's legislative processes. While its commitment to democratic socialism garners substantial grassroots support, the party faces challenges in balancing socialist principles with the practicalities of democratic governance and ensuring the economic feasibility of its ambitious social policies.
'''Progressive People's Party (PPP)''' - Progressive People's Party (PPP) of Aurendale is a political party known for its commitment to social liberalism and environmental advocacy. Championing progressive values, the PPP focuses on individual rights, equality, and social justice, while emphasizing the need for environmental sustainability. The party advocates for policies that support renewable energy, conservation efforts, and climate change mitigation. It also prioritizes social issues such as racial justice. The PPP has a dynamic presence in Aurendale's political landscape, appealing to a diverse electorate, particularly among younger and environmentally conscious voters. Balancing social progressivism with environmental responsibility, the PPP plays a crucial role in shaping Aurendale's legislative agenda and public discourse on contemporary social and environmental issues.
'''New Tech Alliance (NTA)''' - Under the leadership of Prime Minister [[Matthieu Richelieu]], the New Tech Alliance (NTA) has positioned itself as a pioneering force in Aurendale's political landscape, characterized by its techno-progressivism and digital rights advocacy. The NTA's key technological initiatives focus on renewable and progressive energy sources, notably funding future nuclear power plant projects and military advancements like the [[w:Dassault_Mirage|Mirage]] Series of Aircraft. Internationally, the NTA pursues aggressive economic domination strategies, a necessity stemming from Aurendale's small population. Over the last decade, the NTA has transformed Aurendale into a more assertive nation, seeking to expand its influence while instilling a sense of nationalistic pride among its citizens<ref>The [[Khopda Taoist Revolutionary Revolt of 1994|'''Khopda Taoist Revolutionary Revolt of 1994''']] Revolt was one of NTA's biggest achievements with the creation and involvement the [[Aurendale Foreign Legion]] within Khopda, the leading force for the Socialist Republic of Aurendale in the 21st Century.</ref>. = Republic of Aurendale =
The '''Republic of Aurendale''' is a picturesque island nation located in the [[Serenith Ocean]], roughly between the [[Kingdom of Khopda]] & [[Serranova Military Junta]]. Known for its lush landscapes and technologically advanced cities, Aurendale has become a hub for innovative sustainable technologies, specifically those related to renewable energy. Its capital, [[Charcelle]], is powered entirely by Wind, Solar Energy, & Nuclear Power. Its economy is heavily reliant on the exports of high-tech products, pharmaceuticals, and its world-renowned Aurendalian whiskey. The official language is [[Aurendalian]].
= History =
== Imperial Period == Prior to the [[Avant Great War]], Aurendale was an absolute monarchy under the [[House of Montclair]]. The [[Empire of Aurendale]] was ruled with an iron fist by Emperor [[Théodoric X]], who maintained strict control over all aspects of society. Despite its authoritarian nature, the empire was known for its prosperous trade networks and cultural achievements. The war's devastation and the subsequent economic crisis, combined with growing discontent among the working class, created the conditions for revolutionary change.
== Kaonist Revolution (1949-1951) == Following the [[Avant Great War]], Aurendale became the first nation to experience a [[Kaonism|Kaonist]] revolution. While Kaonist philosophy traditionally advocated for peaceful change, the Aurendalian revolution took a violent turn due to the oppressive nature of the imperial regime. The revolution was led by [[Jean-Pierre Moreau]], a former philosophy professor who had studied the works of [[Liao Zhengyuan]] but adapted Kaonist principles to the revolutionary context.
Key events of the revolution included: * The '''[[Bloody Harvest]]''' (1949) - A violent uprising in the agricultural regions, where peasant militias overthrew local imperial administrators * The '''[[Siege of Charcelle]]''' (1950) - A three-month battle that resulted in the fall of the imperial capital * The '''[[Execution of Théodoric X]]''' (1950) - The public trial and execution of the last emperor * The '''[[Great Purge]]''' (1951) - Systematic elimination of imperial loyalists and aristocracy
== Republic (1951-Present) == Following the violent overthrow of the monarchy in 1951, the Republic of Aurendale was established. The new government implemented Kaonist-inspired policies, though with significant modifications to the original philosophy: * Forced collectivization of all major industries * Establishment of revolutionary tribunals * Implementation of the moralized authority system in government, though with a more militant interpretation * Development of the revolutionary education system
== Modern Era == In the 1970s, Aurendale began transitioning from its revolutionary Kaonist principles to a more pragmatic democratic kaonist system under the [[Democratic Kaonist Party (Aurendale)|Democratic Kaonist Party]]. This period saw: * The rise of the [[Democratic Kaonist Party (Aurendale)|Democratic Kaonist Party]] * Integration of modern technology with revolutionary traditions * Expansion of international trade while maintaining state control of key industries * Development of the sustainable technology sector
The DKP's policies led to a significant economic revival, with particular success in: * The '''[[Aurendalian Economic Miracle]]''' (1975-1985) - A period of unprecedented growth and industrial development * The '''[[Green Revolution Initiative]]''' (1978) - Establishment of Aurendale as a leader in sustainable technology * The '''[[Workers' Welfare Program]]''' (1980) - Comprehensive social welfare reforms
However, in the late 1980s, the political landscape began to shift dramatically with the rise of the [[New Tech Alliance (Aurendale)|New Tech Alliance]] (NTA). Under the leadership of [[Matthieu Richelieu]], the NTA gained prominence by: * Capitalizing on growing dissatisfaction with the DKP's traditionalist approach * Promoting aggressive technological advancement and military modernization * Advocating for more assertive foreign policies * Pushing for the creation of the [[Aurendale Foreign Legion]]
The NTA's rise to power marked a significant departure from Aurendale's Kaonist roots, though many traditional structures and rituals were maintained for cultural continuity.
== Government and politics ==
=== Political Sphere === Aurendale operates as a democratic kaonist republic, where the principles of social justice and equality are deeply embedded in its governance structure. The nation's political system is built around a parliamentary framework, with the Prime Minister serving as the head of government.
The legislative branch consists of two chambers: * The National Assembly - Directly elected by citizens * The Senate - Selected by the National Assembly from qualified nominees
This dual-chamber system ensures both direct representation and expert oversight in the legislative process. The party or coalition that secures a majority in the National Assembly forms the government, maintaining a balance between democratic principles and kaonist values.
=== Political Parties ===
'''Democratic Kaonist Party (DKP)''' The DKP stands as Aurendale's dominant political force, championing workers' rights and comprehensive social welfare. Its platform focuses on: * Progressive taxation and wealth redistribution * Universal access to education and healthcare * Fair labor practices and economic reforms
While maintaining strong grassroots support, the party faces ongoing challenges in reconciling traditional kaonist principles with modern governance demands.
'''Progressive People's Party (PPP)''' The PPP represents Aurendale's progressive wing, combining social liberalism with environmental advocacy. Its core priorities include: * Environmental sustainability and renewable energy * Social justice and individual rights * Climate change mitigation
The party particularly resonates with younger voters and environmental activists, playing a crucial role in shaping Aurendale's environmental policies.
'''New Tech Alliance (NTA)''' Under Prime Minister [[Matthieu Richelieu]], the NTA has emerged as a transformative force in Aurendale's political landscape. The party's agenda focuses on: * Technological innovation and digital rights * Military modernization and nuclear energy development * Aggressive economic strategies
The NTA's most notable achievement was its involvement in the [[Khopda Taoist Revolutionary Revolt of 1994]], where the [[Aurendale Foreign Legion]] played a pivotal role. This marked a significant shift in Aurendale's foreign policy approach.
=== Economy === Aurendale's economy is built on three main pillars. The high-tech sector leads in sustainable technology development, pharmaceutical research, and digital services. Traditional industries maintain strong positions in whiskey production, agriculture, and financial services. Energy production focuses on wind, solar, and nuclear power generation, with significant investments in energy storage solutions.
The nation's economic strategy emphasizes balancing technological innovation with traditional industries, with particular focus on sustainable development and renewable energy. This approach has positioned Aurendale as a leader in green technology while maintaining its cultural heritage in traditional sectors.
=== Military === [[File:AurendaleSoldiers1980s.jpg|thumb|'''Aurendale Infantry in the 1980s''']]
The Aurendale Defence Force (ADF) has undergone significant transformation since its founding. During the Early Kaonist Period (1960s-1980s), the military maintained a defensive-oriented doctrine focused on territorial protection. The force was minimalist but professional, with an emphasis on cyber defense and peacekeeping missions. The ADF strictly adhered to non-proliferation policies, maintaining no nuclear or chemical weapons.
In the Modern Era (1990s-Present), the ADF has evolved into a power projection force. Naval capabilities expanded significantly with the introduction of the Liberté-Class Supercarrier program, development of blue-water capabilities, and modernization of the surface fleet. Air power grew to include advanced fighter aircraft, strategic bombers, and carrier-based aviation. Ground forces developed mechanized infantry divisions, special operations capabilities, and rapid deployment forces. Strategic capabilities now include a nuclear-powered carrier fleet, long-range strike capabilities, and global power projection through an integrated command structure.
=== Aurendale Foreign Legion === [[File:AurendaleForeignLegion.jpg|thumb|'''Aurendale Foreign Legion during the Khopda Taoist Revolutionary Revolt''']]
The Aurendale Foreign Legion (AFL) was established in 1994 during the Khopda Taoist Revolutionary Revolt of 1994, marking a significant shift in Aurendale's military doctrine. Initially formed as an expeditionary force, the Legion has evolved into Aurendale's premier power projection unit.
During its formation and early operations, the Legion was created in response to the Khopda crisis, composed of both Aurendalian and foreign volunteers. It specialized in counter-insurgency operations and played a pivotal role in securing Khopda's urban centers. The Legion maintains an independent command structure with a combined arms approach, featuring specialized rapid deployment units and integrated intelligence capabilities.
The Legion's notable operations include the Khopda Taoist Revolutionary Revolt of 1994 (1994-1997) and the Astorian-Volgastani War (2003-2006). In its modern role, the Legion serves as Aurendale's primary expeditionary force with rapid deployment capabilities and special operations expertise. The Legion's success in Khopda established it as Aurendale's primary tool for power projection, combining traditional military capabilities with specialized counter-insurgency expertise.

This economic transformation was accompanied by the establishment of [[Revolutionary Tribunals]], which operated under the [[Moralized Authority System]] to ensure adherence to the new revolutionary principles.
The education system underwent a complete overhaul with the implementation of the [[Revolutionary Education Reform Act of 1952]], which established a network of [[People's Universities]] and [[Technical Institutes]]. The [[Green Technology Initiative]] (1976) established Aurendale as a global leader in renewable energy research and development. The [[Aurendale Defence Force]] continued to modernize, with the introduction of the [[Advanced Combat System]] and the development of the [[Strategic Defense Network]]. == Republic (1951-Present) == Following the violent overthrow of the monarchy in 1951, the [[Republic of Aurendale]] was established under the leadership of [[Jean-Pierre Moreau]] and the [[Revolutionary Council]]. The new government implemented Kaonist-inspired policies, though with significant modifications to the original philosophy to suit Aurendale's unique circumstances. The immediate post-revolutionary period was marked by sweeping reforms across all sectors of society. The [[Aurendale Economic Reform Act of 1951]] mandated the forced collectivization of all major industries, including the nationalization of the [[Montclair Industrial Complex]] and the [[Charcelle Financial District]]. This economic transformation was accompanied by the establishment of [[Revolutionary Tribunals]], which operated under the [[Moralized Authority System]] to ensure adherence to the new revolutionary principles.
The education system underwent a complete overhaul with the implementation of the [[Revolutionary Education Reform Act of 1952]], which established a network of [[People's Universities]] and [[Technical Institutes]]. These institutions were designed to produce a new generation of technically skilled workers and ideologically committed citizens. The [[Aurendale Cultural Revolution]] (1952-1955) saw the systematic dismantling of imperial-era cultural institutions and their replacement with revolutionary alternatives, including the [[People's Theater Movement]] and the [[Revolutionary Arts Collective]].
Military reforms were equally comprehensive, with the establishment of the [[Aurendale People's Army]] in 1952, which later evolved into the modern [[Aurendale Defence Force]]. The [[Military Reform Act of 1953]] abolished the old imperial military structure and implemented a new system based on revolutionary principles, emphasizing the role of the military as a defender of the people rather than an instrument of state power. This period also saw the creation of the [[Aurendale Intelligence Service]], which played a crucial role in maintaining internal security and countering potential counter-revolutionary activities.
The 1960s witnessed the [[Great Industrialization Program]], which transformed Aurendale from an agricultural society into an industrial power. This was accompanied by the [[Urban Development Initiative]], which saw the construction of new cities and the modernization of existing urban centers. The [[Charcelle Metro System]], completed in 1965, became a symbol of the new Aurendale's commitment to modern infrastructure and public transportation.
== Modern Era == The 1970s marked a significant turning point in Aurendale's history, as the nation began transitioning from its revolutionary Kaonist principles to a more pragmatic democratic kaonist system under the [[Democratic Kaonist Party]]. This transition was spearheaded by [[Prime Minister Lucien Dubois]], who implemented the [[Dubois Reforms]] (1972-1975), which sought to balance revolutionary traditions with modern governance practices. The period saw the establishment of the [[Aurendale Central Bank]] and the implementation of the [[New Economic Policy]], which introduced limited market mechanisms while maintaining state control of key industries.
The rise of the [[Democratic Kaonist Party]] was accompanied by significant technological advancements, particularly in the field of sustainable energy. The [[Green Technology Initiative]] (1976) established Aurendale as a global leader in renewable energy research and development. This initiative led to the creation of the [[Charcelle Solar Array]], the world's largest solar power facility at the time, and the development of the [[Aurendale Wind Power Program]], which revolutionized offshore wind energy technology.
The [[Aurendalian Economic Miracle]] (1975-1985) transformed the nation's economic landscape, with unprecedented growth in the high-tech sector and traditional industries. The [[Workers' Welfare Program]] (1980) established a comprehensive social safety net, including universal healthcare, education, and housing programs. This period also saw the expansion of Aurendale's international trade networks, with the establishment of the [[Aurendale Trade Commission]] and the signing of numerous bilateral trade agreements.
The late 1980s witnessed a dramatic shift in Aurendale's political landscape with the rise of the [[New Tech Alliance]] (NTA) under the leadership of [[Matthieu Richelieu]]. The NTA's ascendancy was marked by the [[Technological Revolution Act of 1989]], which significantly increased funding for research and development in military and civilian technologies. This period saw the establishment of the [[Aurendale Space Program]] and the development of the [[Liberté-Class Supercarrier]] program, which revolutionized Aurendale's naval capabilities.
The 1990s were defined by Aurendale's increasing involvement in international affairs, particularly during the [[Khopda Taoist Revolutionary Revolt of 1994]]. The creation of the [[Aurendale Foreign Legion]] marked a significant departure from the nation's traditional defensive posture, establishing Aurendale as a regional power capable of power projection.
== Aurendale and the AGGPI == Aurendale played a pivotal role in the establishment of the (Avant Garde Global Peace Initiative) [[AGGPI]] in 1995, serving as one of its three founding members alongside [[Solara]] and the [[Union of Zhensanov]]. The nation's involvement stemmed from its commitment to global peacekeeping and sustainable development, particularly in the aftermath of the [[Solaran-Khalindarian War (1990-1994)]].
As a founding member, Aurendale contributed significantly to the AGGPI's structure and operations: * Establishment of the [[General Assembly of the AGGPI|General Assembly]], where Aurendale maintains a seat * Development of the [[AGGPIPF|Peacekeeping Force]] * Creation of the [[Secretariat of the AGGPI|Secretariat]], with Aurendale hosting one of the four regional offices
Aurendale's role in the AGGPI has significantly influenced its foreign policy, transforming it from a traditionally isolationist nation to a key player in global peacekeeping and development efforts. This shift was particularly evident during the [[Khopda Taoist Revolutionary Revolt of 1994]], where Aurendale's intervention under AGGPI mandate marked a turning point in its international engagement.
== Government and politics ==
=== Political Sphere === Aurendale operates as a democratic kaonist republic, where the principles of social justice and equality are deeply embedded in its governance structure. The nation's political system is built around a parliamentary framework, with the Prime Minister serving as the head of government.
The legislative branch consists of two chambers: * The National Assembly - Directly elected by citizens * The Senate - Selected by the National Assembly from qualified nominees
This dual-chamber system ensures both direct representation and expert oversight in the legislative process. The party or coalition that secures a majority in the National Assembly forms the government, maintaining a balance between democratic principles and kaonist values.
=== Political Parties ===
'''Democratic Kaonist Party (DKP)''' The DKP stands as Aurendale's dominant political force, championing workers' rights and comprehensive social welfare. Its platform focuses on: * Progressive taxation and wealth redistribution * Universal access to education and healthcare * Fair labor practices and economic reforms
While maintaining strong grassroots support, the party faces ongoing challenges in reconciling traditional kaonist principles with modern governance demands.
'''Progressive People's Party (PPP)''' The PPP represents Aurendale's progressive wing, combining social liberalism with environmental advocacy. Its core priorities include: * Environmental sustainability and renewable energy * Social justice and individual rights * Climate change mitigation
The party particularly resonates with younger voters and environmental activists, playing a crucial role in shaping Aurendale's environmental policies.
'''New Tech Alliance (NTA)''' Under Prime Minister [[Matthieu Richelieu]], the NTA has emerged as a transformative force in Aurendale's political landscape. The party's agenda focuses on: * Technological innovation and digital rights * Military modernization and nuclear energy development * Aggressive economic strategies
The NTA's most notable achievement was its involvement in the [[Khopda Taoist Revolutionary Revolt of 1994]], where the [[Aurendale Foreign Legion]] played a pivotal role. This marked a significant shift in Aurendale's foreign policy approach.
=== Economy === Aurendale's economy is built on three main pillars. The high-tech sector leads in sustainable technology development, pharmaceutical research, and digital services. Traditional industries maintain strong positions in whiskey production, agriculture, and financial services. Energy production focuses on wind, solar, and nuclear power generation, with significant investments in energy storage solutions.
The nation's economic strategy emphasizes balancing technological innovation with traditional industries, with particular focus on sustainable development and renewable energy. This approach has positioned Aurendale as a leader in green technology while maintaining its cultural heritage in traditional sectors.
=== Military === [[File:AurendaleSoldiers1980s.jpg|thumb|'''Aurendale Infantry in the 1980s''']]
The [[Aurendale Defence Force]] (ADF) has undergone significant transformation since its founding. During the Early Kaonist Period (1960s-1980s), the military maintained a defensive-oriented doctrine focused on territorial protection. The force was minimalist but professional, with an emphasis on cyber defense and peacekeeping missions. The ADF strictly adhered to non-proliferation policies, maintaining no nuclear or chemical weapons.
In the Modern Era (1990s-Present), the ADF has evolved into a power projection force. Naval capabilities expanded significantly with the introduction of the [[Liberté-Class Supercarrier]] program, development of blue-water capabilities, and modernization of the surface fleet. Air power grew to include advanced fighter aircraft, strategic bombers, and carrier-based aviation. Ground forces developed mechanized infantry divisions, special operations capabilities, and rapid deployment forces. Strategic capabilities now include a nuclear-powered carrier fleet, long-range strike capabilities, and global power projection through an integrated command structure.
=== Aurendale Foreign Legion === [[File:AurendaleForeignLegion.jpg|thumb|'''Aurendale Foreign Legion during the Khopda Taoist Revolutionary Revolt''']]
The [[Aurendale Foreign Legion]] (AFL) was established in 1994 during the [[Khopda Taoist Revolutionary Revolt of 1994]], marking a significant shift in Aurendale's military doctrine. Initially formed as an expeditionary force, the Legion has evolved into Aurendale's premier power projection unit.
During its formation and early operations, the Legion was created in response to the Khopda crisis, composed of both Aurendalian and foreign volunteers. It specialized in counter-insurgency operations and played a pivotal role in securing Khopda's urban centers. The Legion maintains an independent command structure with a combined arms approach, featuring specialized rapid deployment units and integrated intelligence capabilities.
The Legion's notable operations include the [[Khopda Taoist Revolutionary Revolt of 1994]] (1994-1997) and the [[Astorian-Volgastani War]] (2003-2006). In its modern role, the Legion serves as Aurendale's primary expeditionary force with rapid deployment capabilities and special operations expertise. The Legion's success in Khopda established it as Aurendale's primary tool for power projection, combining traditional military capabilities with specialized counter-insurgency expertise.
