The [[Naval Reform Act of 1924]] initiated a massive expansion of Solara's naval capabilities, focusing on the development of advanced naval tactics and doctrine. The modernization of the fleet with new ship designs became a top priority, as did the enhancement of naval aviation capabilities. The establishment of specialized naval training facilities across the nation ensured that the Solaran Navy would maintain its edge in both conventional and arctic warfare scenarios, despite facing the world's most powerful navy.
These reforms bore fruit in the [[Great Naval Campaign of 1927]], where Solara achieved a series of remarkable victories against the Vesperan Navy. The [[Battle of the Ice Floes]] (1927) became a defining moment in Solaran naval history, as the newly modernized fleet demonstrated its superiority in arctic conditions against the Vesperan forces. The campaign culminated in the [[Treaty of Maritime Peace]] (1928), which established clear boundaries and protocols for naval operations in the region, marking a rare diplomatic achievement against the global superpower.
==== Military Modernization (1930-1937) ==== The success of the naval reforms led to a comprehensive review of Solara's entire military structure. The [[Military Reform Period]] (1930-1937) saw the complete reorganization of Solara's armed forces, with particular emphasis on the integration of naval and ground forces operations. The development of specialized arctic warfare units became a cornerstone of military strategy, while the enhancement of special operations capabilities ensured Solara's ability to conduct complex operations in extreme conditions. The modernization of military infrastructure across the nation supported these new capabilities, creating a more robust and flexible defense network.
This period also saw the establishment of the [[Solaran Naval Academy]] (1932) and the [[Arctic Warfare Training Center]] (1934), institutions that would become cornerstones of Solara's military excellence. The [[Military Modernization Act]] of 1935 formalized these changes, creating a more flexible and responsive military structure capable of operating effectively in both conventional and asymmetric warfare scenarios. These reforms would prove crucial in the coming global conflict, as Solara's military demonstrated its ability to adapt to changing strategic circumstances and maintain its position as a leading military power.
==== Avant Great War (1937-1949) ==== Solara played a crucial role in the [[Avant Great War]] as a leading member of the United Alignment of Nations. The conflict, which lasted from 1937 to 1949, was the deadliest in history with 105-128 million fatalities globally. For detailed information about the war, see [[Avant Great War]].
==== Post-War Development (1949-1989) ==== The aftermath of the Great War saw Solara emerge as a global superpower, though significantly weakened by the conflict. The nation's recovery and subsequent rise to prominence was marked by several distinct phases of development, each contributing to Solara's eventual position as a leading military and technological power.
The [[Industrial Recovery Program]] (1949-1959) represented the first phase of Solara's post-war reconstruction. This decade-long initiative focused on rebuilding the nation's devastated infrastructure while simultaneously expanding industrial capacity. The program saw the construction of new shipyards in Congrave and Frostfell, the establishment of advanced manufacturing facilities in Suncrown, and the modernization of transportation networks across the nation. The private military sector flourished during this period, with [[SolarTech Aerospace Corporation]] and [[Luminex Weapons Systems]] emerging as the dominant manufacturers, supported by hundreds of smaller specialized defense contractors. These companies would become the backbone of Solara's military-industrial complex, developing new technologies and production methods that would shape the nation's future capabilities.
The [[Military Modernization]] period (1960-1970) integrated the hard-won lessons of the Great War into Solara's military doctrine. This era witnessed the complete overhaul of the Solaran Armed Forces, with particular emphasis on missile technology and naval power. The [[Ballistic Missile Program]] (1960-1965) established Solara's medium-range missile capabilities, though further development of these weapons systems was not pursued. The [[Naval Expansion Initiative]] (1965-1970) saw the construction of a new generation of warships, including the revolutionary [[w:Nimitz-class aircraft carrier|Nimitz-class]] aircraft carriers and [[w:Ohio-class submarine|Ohio-class]] nuclear submarines. These vessels would form the core of Solara's blue-water navy, ensuring the nation's ability to project power across the southern oceans.
The [[Technological Revolution]] (1970-1980) marked a period of unprecedented advancement in military technology and weapons systems. Research facilities across Solara worked tirelessly to develop new technologies, with particular focus on: * Advanced propulsion systems for naval vessels * Next-generation fighter aircraft * Precision-guided munitions * Electronic warfare capabilities * Space-based surveillance and communication systems
The [[Defense Initiative]] (1980-1989) focused on strengthening Solara's defensive capabilities through a comprehensive modernization of all military branches. The [[Air Defense Modernization Program]] (1980-1984) introduced new surface-to-air missile systems and advanced radar networks, while the [[Naval Fleet Expansion]] (1985-1989) saw the construction of additional carrier groups and amphibious assault ships. The [[Ground Forces Modernization]] (1980-1989) transformed Solara's army into a highly mobile, technologically advanced force, with new armored vehicles, artillery systems, and infantry equipment.
Throughout this period, Solara's military-industrial complex grew exponentially, with [[SolarTech Aerospace Corporation]] and [[Luminex Weapons Systems]] emerging as the world's leading manufacturers of military equipment. These corporations produced everything from small arms to aircraft carriers, supported by a vast network of specialized subcontractors and research facilities. The nation's research and development capabilities were further enhanced by private sector initiatives, which focused on developing next-generation weapons systems and military technologies.
The final years of this period (1985-1989) saw Solara basking in its status as a global superpower, having achieved unprecedented military and economic dominance. The nation's leadership and population grew increasingly confident, even arrogant, in their position of privilege and power. The [[Military Modernization Act]] of 1987 was less about preparing for potential conflicts and more about maintaining Solara's position at the pinnacle of global military power. By the end of 1989, Solara had fully embraced its role as a dominant superpower, with its citizens enjoying the benefits of military supremacy and economic prosperity.
As the world entered a more peaceful era in the early 1990s, Solara's military advancements slowed significantly. The nation's leadership, confident in their military superiority, reduced defense spending and focused more on economic development and international diplomacy. This period of complacency would prove costly when the [[Solara-Khalindar War]] erupted in 1990. The surprise attack on [[Albroke Naval Harbors]] caught Solara completely unprepared, resulting in the loss of over 30% of the Solaran Navy, including several aircraft carriers. This devastating blow marked the beginning of one of the most brutal conflicts in Solara's history, forcing the nation to rapidly mobilize its remaining forces and industrial capacity to respond to the Khalindarian threat.
==== Solara-Khalindar War (1990-1994) ==== The [[Solara-Khalindar War]] marked one of the most significant conflicts in recent history, with Khalindar's aggressive expansion leading to a series of brutal battles. The [[Battle of Albridge]] in 1990 demonstrated Solara's maritime capabilities, while the prolonged [[Siege of Grayhaven]] (1990-1991) tested the nation's resilience and military effectiveness. The tide of the war turned with [[Operation Dawnfire]] (1991-1992), a strategic campaign that showcased Solara's military prowess and determination.
The conflict resulted in over 1.5 million Solaran casualties (500,000 military, 1,000,000 civilian) and concluded in a stalemate by 1994. The war's aftermath led to significant military reforms and modernization efforts in Solara, as the nation sought to learn from the lessons of the conflict and strengthen its defensive capabilities.
=== Modern Military Structure === The modern Solaran Armed Forces emerged from the crucible of the Solara-Khalindar War as a highly specialized and technologically advanced military force. The [[Solaran Horizon Naval Corps]] (SHNC) forms the backbone of Solara's maritime power, maintaining a formidable blue-water navy with advanced submarine capabilities and a dedicated Marine Corps division. Specializing in fleet engagements, maritime security, and amphibious operations, the Naval Corps has become one of the most respected naval forces in the world.
The [[Solaran Aero Legion]] (SAL) represents the nation's air power, operating a modern fleet of fighter aircraft and strategic bombers. Specializing in heavy air assaults and close air support, the Aero Legion maintains air superiority through advanced air defense systems and rapid deployment capabilities. The [[Solaran Expeditionary Force]] (SEF) serves as the primary ground and special operations branch, conducting large-scale operations and commanding all special operations through the elite [[Solaran Rangers]].
The [[Solaran Rangers]] represent the pinnacle of Solara's special operations capabilities, with the legendary [[95th Ranger Regiment]] at its core. Known as the "Ghost Warriors," this elite unit, led by Ashton Knight during the Khalindarian War, has become synonymous with Solaran military excellence. The Rangers encompass both regular regiments specializing in shock combat and heavy engagements, as well as Tier One Special Operations Units like the [[Special Mission Units]] and the premier [[Luminary Units]]. These elite units specialize in covert operations, intelligence gathering, and critical strategic operations.
Solaran military culture is deeply rooted in tradition and excellence, with the [[Ranger's Creed]] serving as a sacred oath for all special forces personnel. The [[Ice Warrior Ritual]] marks the initiation of new special forces members, while the annual [[Sun's Guard Ceremony]] showcases the nation's military might. The [[Arctic Warrior Training]] program continues to produce elite cold weather combat specialists, maintaining Solara's edge in arctic warfare capabilities.
The nation's military-industrial complex, led by [[SolarTech Aerospace Corporation]] and [[Luminex Weapons Systems]], continues to develop and produce cutting-edge military technology. These corporations, supported by hundreds of specialized subcontractors, ensure that Solara's armed forces remain at the forefront of military innovation and capability.
=== Administrative Divisions ===
Solara is divided into eight distinct administrative regions, each with its own unique characteristics and governance structure. The northern region of [[Northreach]] serves as a crucial industrial and military hub, while the central region of [[Suncrown]] forms the nation's political and economic heartland. The southern region of [[Frostfell]] is known for its arctic training facilities and resource extraction operations, while the coastal regions of [[Dawngate]] and [[Duskwall]] maintain Solara's vital maritime infrastructure. The mountainous region of [[Peakhold]] provides strategic defensive positions and mining operations, while [[Tidemark]] along the coast serves as a major naval and commercial port area. The interior region of [[Heartland]] forms the agricultural backbone of the nation.
Each region maintains its own comprehensive governance structure, including a Regional Assembly (regency) responsible for local legislation, an Administrative Council (council) overseeing day-to-day operations, and Regional Courts (justiciar) handling local legal matters. The Development Authority (steward) in each region manages infrastructure and economic projects, while the Education Board (scholars) ensures consistent educational standards across the nation. This decentralized system allows for regional autonomy while maintaining national unity and standards.
== Government ==
=== Political Structure === Solara operates as a parliamentary democracy with a strong emphasis on transparency and public participation. The government is structured into three main branches, each with distinct responsibilities and powers. The Executive Branch, headed by President Jason Knight and Vice President Arthur "Lee" Dumont, includes a cabinet of ministers overseeing various departments and implementing national policies. The Legislative Branch, consisting of a Parliament with over 300 representatives, operates under a multi-party system and is responsible for law-making and government oversight. The Judicial Branch maintains an independent judiciary with a constitutional court and separate civil and criminal courts, ensuring the rule of law and protection of citizens' rights.
=== Political Parties === The Solaran political landscape is diverse and dynamic, with several major political parties representing different ideologies and interests. The [[Solara Unity Party]] (SUP), currently the ruling party under President Knight, represents center-right policies focusing on national unity and military strength while advocating for traditional Solaran values. The [[Conservative Solaran Party]] (CSP) takes a right-wing stance, emphasizing military preparedness and economic protectionism with strong support for traditional Sonist values. The [[Patriotic Solaran Union]] (PSU) promotes aggressive foreign policy, particularly towards Khalindar, and advocates for military modernization.
On the center-left, the [[Solaran Progressive Alliance]] (SPA) champions social welfare and civil rights while supporting environmental protection and renewable energy initiatives. The [[Solaran Liberty Front]] (SLF) occupies the political center, advocating for individual freedoms and market liberalization while promoting diplomatic solutions to international conflicts. The left-wing [[Solaran People's Party]] (SPP) focuses on workers' rights and social equality, supporting increased public spending on education and healthcare. The [[Solaran Green Party]] (SGP) emphasizes environmental protection and sustainable development, advocating for renewable energy and conservation. The [[Future Solara Movement]] (FSM) promotes technological innovation and modernization, supporting education reform and digital transformation.
The nation has developed efficient resource management and recycling systems to maintain industrial self-sufficiency where possible, though some raw materials must be imported. The national currency, the Solari, is managed by the Solaran Central Bank, ensuring economic stability and growth.
== Demographics ==
=== Population ===
According to the 2010 census, Solara has a population of 164 million people. The population is primarily urban, with over 75% of citizens living in major cities. The capital region of Congrave forms the largest metropolitan area with approximately 15 million inhabitants.
=== Ethnic Groups ===
The Solaran population consists of: * '''[[Solaran Language|Solaran]]''' (96.5%) - The dominant ethnic group * '''Others''' (3.5%) - Including various immigrant communities
=== Languages ===
The official language is [[Solaran Language|Solaran]], a unique language that developed from Ancient Solaran. Key characteristics include: * Complex grammatical structure * Specialized military and technical vocabulary * Regional dialects maintaining mutual intelligibility * Influence on international military terminology * Ceremonial use of [[Solra]], the Elder Tongue, in religious and state functions
=== Religion === [[Sonism]], the predominant religion, centers around the worship of the sun deity Son and emphasizes values of enlightenment, strength, and unity. The faith influences daily life through: * Regular solar observances * Traditional festivals marking solstices and equinoxes * Integration with democratic values * Emphasis on personal growth and national service

=Solara=
'''Solara''' ({{lang|sol|Solara}}), commonly known as the '''Republic of Solara''', is a parliamentary democracy located in the southern region of Avant. Founded in 1538 following the [[Solaran War of Unification]], the nation has emerged as one of the world's leading military and industrial powers. With a population of approximately 164 million people and a land area of 6,900,000 km², Solara is a major force in global affairs.{{Infobox country | conventional_long_name = Solara | image_flag = [[File:SolaraFlag.png|border|250px|Flag of Solara]] | flag_width = 250 | image_coat = [[File:SolaranSeal.png|border|150px|Coat of Arms of Solara]] | symbol_width = 150 | flag_footnote = The National Flag of Solara, featuring the traditional colors | national_motto = "The Only Good Khalindarian, is a Dead Khalindarian." | national_anthem = "O Solara" | image_map = [[File:SolaraMap.png|border|300px|Map of Solara]] | alt_map = Map of Solara | map_caption = Solara (in blue) and its territories | capital = Congrave | largest_city = Congrave | official_languages = Solarian | ethnic_groups = {{unbulleted list |item_style=font-size: | 96.5% [[Solaran]] | 3.5% Others }} | religion = [[Sonism|Sonist]] | demonym = Solarian | government_type = [[w:Parliamentary_system|Parliamentary Democracy]] | leader_title1 = [[President of Solara|President]] | leader_name1 = Jason Knight | leader_title2 = [[Vice President of Solara|Vice President]] | leader_name2 = Arthur "Lee" Dumont | legislature = Parliament of Solara | established_event1 = Formation | established_date1 = 1538 | currency = Solari | currency_code = SOL | time_zone = [[Alberion Central|AC]] | utc_offset = -11 | date_format = DD/MM/YYYY | drives_on = right | calling_code = +1 | iso3166code = SL | cctld = .sl | p1 = Grand Duchy of Solan | flag_p1 = GrandDuchyofSolan.png | border_p1 = no | p2 = Kingdom of Congrave | flag_p2 = KingdomofCongrave.png | border_p2 = no | p3 = Kingdom of Albion | flag_p3 = KingdomofAlbion.png | border_p3 = no }}
The nation's capital and largest city is Congrave, which serves as the political, economic, and cultural center. Solara's official language is Solarian, and it operates under a parliamentary democratic system, with President Jason Knight as the current head of state.
Known for its technological advancement and military might, particularly in naval warfare and nuclear technology, Solara has maintained its position as a global superpower through continuous innovation and strategic development. The nation's economy, centered around high-tech manufacturing and military production, has shown remarkable resilience and adaptability throughout its history.
== Etymology ==
The name "Solara" has its roots in the ancient [[Solra|Elder Tongue]], where it was originally written as 𐍖𐰇𐰴𐰤 (pronounced /ˈsolra/). The name is composed of two elements:
* '''Sol''' (𐍖𐰇) - Meaning "sun" or "radiance," derived from the proto-Solaran root *sōl-, which also gave rise to the modern Solaran word for sun (sol) and the religious concept of [[Sonism|Son]] (the sun deity).
* '''Ara''' (𐰴𐰤) - Meaning "land," "realm," or "domain," from the proto-Solaran root *ar-, which evolved into the modern Solaran word for land (ara).
The combination "Solara" thus translates to "Land of the Sun" or "Sun Realm," reflecting both the nation's geographical position in the southern regions of Avant and its deep cultural connection to solar worship. This etymology is particularly significant as it:
* Reflects the nation's founding principles of enlightenment and divine guidance * Symbolizes the unity of the three original kingdoms under a single solar banner * Maintains continuity with the ancient [[Solra|Elder Tongue]] used in religious and ceremonial contexts * Embodies the nation's identity as a beacon of civilization and progress
The name was officially adopted during the [[Solaran War of Unification]] in 1538, when General Marcus Solaris united the [[Grand Duchy of Solan]], [[Kingdom of Congrave]], and conquered territories of the [[Kingdom of Albion]]. The choice of name was deliberate, symbolizing not just the unification of territories but also the establishment of a new era under the guidance of the sun deity.
In modern [[Solaran Language|Solaran]], the name is pronounced /soˈlaːra/, with the stress on the second syllable, a development from the original Elder Tongue pronunciation that occurred during the language's evolution in the 16th century.
== History ==
=== Early Years (1538-1900) === The foundation of modern Solara was forged in the crucible of the [[Solaran War of Unification]], a transformative period that reshaped the southern region of Avant. Under the leadership of General Marcus Solaris, the scattered territories of the [[Grand Duchy of Solan]], [[Kingdom of Congrave]], and [[Kingdom of Albion]] were united through a series of brilliant military campaigns known as the [[Seven Years' March]]. The decisive [[Battle of the Three Crowns]] in 1538 marked the turning point of the unification, where General Solaris achieved a stunning victory over the combined armies of Albion and rebel Congrave forces. This victory was followed by the [[Siege of Fort Luminara]] in 1539, a grueling six-month campaign that secured Solara's northern borders and demonstrated the resilience of the newly formed nation.
The [[Treaty of Eternal Light]] in 1540 established Solara's initial borders and governmental structure, creating a framework that would guide the nation's development for centuries. This treaty not only formalized the unification but also established the principles of solar worship as the foundation of the new state. The subsequent decades saw the emergence of the modern Solaran navy under Admiral James Horizon during the [[Great Naval Reform]] (1545-1550), which established Solara's maritime traditions and capabilities. This period witnessed the construction of the first modern shipyards and the development of specialized naval tactics that would become hallmarks of Solaran military doctrine.
The [[First Industrial Revolution]] (1550-1600) marked a significant turning point in Solara's development, as the nation focused its industrial capacity on military production and technological advancement. This period saw the establishment of the first modern shipyards, armories, and military research facilities that would become the foundation of Solara's industrial might. The [[Arctic Expansion Campaign]] (1600-1650) further solidified Solara's position, as the nation systematically colonized the southern ice sheets, establishing strategic outposts and resource extraction facilities that would prove crucial in later conflicts.
The 17th century saw the development of Solara's unique military culture, with the establishment of the [[Solaran Military Academy]] in 1655 and the codification of the [[Ranger's Creed]] in 1672. These institutions laid the groundwork for Solara's elite military forces and established the principles of honor, duty, and sacrifice that would define Solaran military tradition. The [[Great Northern Campaign]] (1680-1690) focused on establishing a comprehensive coastal defense network, with fortified positions and naval bases strategically placed around the island's perimeter. This was complemented by the [[Southern Defense Initiative]] (1695-1705), which established a network of fortifications and observation posts along the southern ice sheets.
The 18th century witnessed the rise of Solara as a major naval power, with the [[Naval Expansion Act]] of 1720 leading to the construction of a formidable fleet. The [[Arctic Warrior Program]] (1730-1740) developed specialized training for operations in extreme cold conditions, while the [[Southern Resistance Doctrine]] (1750-1760) established tactics for guerrilla warfare in arctic conditions. These developments proved crucial during the [[Coastal Defense Campaigns]] (1770-1780), where Solara successfully repelled multiple naval incursions and maintained its territorial integrity.
The 19th century saw Solara's transformation into an industrial powerhouse, with the [[Second Industrial Revolution]] (1800-1850) bringing about significant technological advancements. The [[Military Modernization Act]] of 1820 established the framework for a professional standing army, while the [[Naval Supremacy Program]] (1830-1840) ensured Solara's dominance in regional waters. The [[Arctic Research Initiative]] (1850-1860) led to breakthroughs in cold-weather technology and survival techniques, while the [[Southern Defense Network]] (1870-1880) created a comprehensive system of fortifications and early warning stations.

The program's graduates formed the core of what would later become the [[95th Ranger Regiment]], developing tactics that would prove crucial in future conflicts.

This period of complacency would prove costly when the [[Solara-Khalindar War]] erupted in 1990. The surprise attack on [[Albroke Naval Harbors]] caught Solara completely unprepared, resulting in the loss of over 30% of the Solaran Navy, including several aircraft carriers. This devastating blow marked the beginning of one of the most brutal conflicts in Solara's history, forcing the nation to rapidly mobilize its remaining forces and industrial capacity to respond to the Khalindarian threat.
==== Solara-Khalindar War (1990-1994) ==== The [[Solara-Khalindar War]] marked one of the most significant conflicts in recent history, with Khalindar's aggressive expansion leading to a series of brutal battles. The [[Battle of Albridge]] in 1990 demonstrated Solara's maritime capabilities, while the prolonged [[Siege of Grayhaven]] (1990-1991) tested the nation's resilience and military effectiveness. The tide of the war turned with [[Operation Dawnfire]] (1991-1992), a strategic campaign that showcased Solara's military prowess and determination.
The conflict resulted in over 1.5 million Solaran casualties (500,000 military, 1,000,000 civilian) and concluded in a stalemate by 1994. The war's aftermath led to significant military reforms and modernization efforts in Solara, as the nation sought to learn from the lessons of the conflict and strengthen its defensive capabilities.
=== Modern Military Structure === The modern Solaran Armed Forces emerged from the crucible of the Solara-Khalindar War as a highly specialized and technologically advanced military force. The [[Solaran Horizon Naval Corps]] (SHNC) forms the backbone of Solara's maritime power, maintaining a formidable blue-water navy with advanced submarine capabilities and a dedicated Marine Corps division. Specializing in fleet engagements, maritime security, and amphibious operations, the Naval Corps has become one of the most respected naval forces in the world.
The [[Solaran Aero Legion]] (SAL) represents the nation's air power, operating a modern fleet of fighter aircraft and strategic bombers. Specializing in heavy air assaults and close air support, the Aero Legion maintains air superiority through advanced air defense systems and rapid deployment capabilities. The [[Solaran Expeditionary Force]] (SEF) serves as the primary ground and special operations branch, conducting large-scale operations and commanding all special operations through the elite [[Solaran Rangers]].
The [[Solaran Rangers]] represent the pinnacle of Solara's special operations capabilities, with the legendary [[95th Ranger Regiment]] at its core. Known as the "Ghost Warriors," this elite unit, led by Ashton Knight during the Khalindarian War, has become synonymous with Solaran military excellence. The Rangers encompass both regular regiments specializing in shock combat and heavy engagements, as well as Tier One Special Operations Units like the [[Special Mission Units]] and the premier [[Luminary Units]]. These elite units specialize in covert operations, intelligence gathering, and critical strategic operations.
Solaran military culture is deeply rooted in tradition and excellence, with the [[Ranger's Creed]] serving as a sacred oath for all special forces personnel. The [[Ice Warrior Ritual]] marks the initiation of new special forces members, while the annual [[Sun's Guard Ceremony]] showcases the nation's military might. The [[Arctic Warrior Training]] program continues to produce elite cold weather combat specialists, maintaining Solara's edge in arctic warfare capabilities.
The nation's military-industrial complex, led by [[SolarTech Aerospace Corporation]] and [[Luminex Weapons Systems]], continues to develop and produce cutting-edge military technology. These corporations, supported by hundreds of specialized subcontractors, ensure that Solara's armed forces remain at the forefront of military innovation and capability.
=== Administrative Divisions ===
Solara is divided into eight distinct administrative regions, each with its own unique characteristics and governance structure. The northern region of [[Northreach]] serves as a crucial industrial and military hub, while the central region of [[Suncrown]] forms the nation's political and economic heartland. The southern region of [[Frostfell]] is known for its arctic training facilities and resource extraction operations, while the coastal regions of [[Dawngate]] and [[Duskwall]] maintain Solara's vital maritime infrastructure. The mountainous region of [[Peakhold]] provides strategic defensive positions and mining operations, while [[Tidemark]] along the coast serves as a major naval and commercial port area. The interior region of [[Heartland]] forms the agricultural backbone of the nation.
Each region maintains its own comprehensive governance structure, including a Regional Assembly (regency) responsible for local legislation, an Administrative Council (council) overseeing day-to-day operations, and Regional Courts (justiciar) handling local legal matters. The Development Authority (steward) in each region manages infrastructure and economic projects, while the Education Board (scholars) ensures consistent educational standards across the nation. This decentralized system allows for regional autonomy while maintaining national unity and standards.
== Government ==
=== Political Structure === Solara operates as a parliamentary democracy with a strong emphasis on transparency and public participation. The government is structured into three main branches, each with distinct responsibilities and powers. The Executive Branch, headed by President Jason Knight and Vice President Arthur "Lee" Dumont, includes a cabinet of ministers overseeing various departments and implementing national policies. The Legislative Branch, consisting of a Parliament with over 300 representatives, operates under a multi-party system and is responsible for law-making and government oversight. The Judicial Branch maintains an independent judiciary with a constitutional court and separate civil and criminal courts, ensuring the rule of law and protection of citizens' rights.
=== Political Parties === The Solaran political landscape is diverse and dynamic, with several major political parties representing different ideologies and interests. The [[Solara Unity Party]] (SUP), currently the ruling party under President Knight, represents center-right policies focusing on national unity and military strength while advocating for traditional Solaran values. The [[Conservative Solaran Party]] (CSP) takes a right-wing stance, emphasizing military preparedness and economic protectionism with strong support for traditional Sonist values. The [[Patriotic Solaran Union]] (PSU) promotes aggressive foreign policy, particularly towards Khalindar, and advocates for military modernization.
On the center-left, the [[Solaran Progressive Alliance]] (SPA) champions social welfare and civil rights while supporting environmental protection and renewable energy initiatives. The [[Solaran Liberty Front]] (SLF) occupies the political center, advocating for individual freedoms and market liberalization while promoting diplomatic solutions to international conflicts. The left-wing [[Solaran People's Party]] (SPP) focuses on workers' rights and social equality, supporting increased public spending on education and healthcare. The [[Solaran Green Party]] (SGP) emphasizes environmental protection and sustainable development, advocating for renewable energy and conservation. The [[Future Solara Movement]] (FSM) promotes technological innovation and modernization, supporting education reform and digital transformation.
The nation has developed efficient resource management and recycling systems to maintain industrial self-sufficiency where possible, though some raw materials must be imported. The national currency, the Solari, is managed by the Solaran Central Bank, ensuring economic stability and growth.
== Demographics ==
=== Population ===
According to the 2010 census, Solara has a population of 164 million people. The population is primarily urban, with over 75% of citizens living in major cities. The capital region of Congrave forms the largest metropolitan area with approximately 15 million inhabitants.
=== Ethnic Groups ===
The Solaran population consists of: * '''[[Solaran Language|Solaran]]''' (96.5%) - The dominant ethnic group * '''Others''' (3.5%) - Including various immigrant communities
=== Languages ===
The official language is [[Solaran Language|Solaran]], a unique language that developed from Ancient Solaran. Key characteristics include: * Complex grammatical structure * Specialized military and technical vocabulary * Regional dialects maintaining mutual intelligibility * Influence on international military terminology * Ceremonial use of [[Solra]], the Elder Tongue, in religious and state functions
=== Religion === [[Sonism]], the predominant religion, centers around the worship of the sun deity Son and emphasizes values of enlightenment, strength, and unity. The faith influences daily life through: * Regular solar observances * Traditional festivals marking solstices and equinoxes * Integration with democratic values * Emphasis on personal growth and national service

=Solara=
'''Solara''' ({{lang|sol|Solara}}), commonly known as the '''Republic of Solara''', is a parliamentary democracy located in the southern region of Avant. Founded in 1538 following the [[Solaran War of Unification]], the nation has emerged as one of the world's leading military and industrial powers. With a population of approximately 164 million people and a land area of 6,900,000 km², Solara is a major force in global affairs.{{Infobox country | conventional_long_name = Solara | image_flag = [[File:SolaraFlag.png|border|250px|Flag of Solara]] | flag_width = 250 | image_coat = [[File:SolaranSeal.png|border|150px|Coat of Arms of Solara]] | symbol_width = 150 | flag_footnote = The National Flag of Solara, featuring the traditional colors | national_motto = "The Only Good Khalindarian, is a Dead Khalindarian." | national_anthem = "O Solara" | image_map = [[File:SolaraMap.png|border|300px|Map of Solara]] | alt_map = Map of Solara | map_caption = Solara (in blue) and its territories | capital = Congrave | largest_city = Congrave | official_languages = Solarian | ethnic_groups = {{unbulleted list |item_style=font-size: | 96.5% [[Solaran]] | 3.5% Others }} | religion = [[Sonism|Sonist]] | demonym = Solarian | government_type = [[w:Parliamentary_system|Parliamentary Democracy]] | leader_title1 = [[President of Solara|President]] | leader_name1 = Jason Knight | leader_title2 = [[Vice President of Solara|Vice President]] | leader_name2 = Arthur "Lee" Dumont | legislature = Parliament of Solara | established_event1 = Formation | established_date1 = 1538 | currency = Solari | currency_code = SOL | time_zone = [[Alberion Central|AC]] | utc_offset = -11 | date_format = DD/MM/YYYY | drives_on = right | calling_code = +1 | iso3166code = SL | cctld = .sl | p1 = Grand Duchy of Solan | flag_p1 = GrandDuchyofSolan.png | border_p1 = no | p2 = Kingdom of Congrave | flag_p2 = KingdomofCongrave.png | border_p2 = no | p3 = Kingdom of Albion | flag_p3 = KingdomofAlbion.png | border_p3 = no }}
The nation's capital and largest city is Congrave, which serves as the political, economic, and cultural center. Solara's official language is Solarian, and it operates under a parliamentary democratic system, with President Jason Knight as the current head of state.
Known for its technological advancement and military might, particularly in naval warfare and nuclear technology, Solara has maintained its position as a global superpower through continuous innovation and strategic development. The nation's economy, centered around high-tech manufacturing and military production, has shown remarkable resilience and adaptability throughout its history.
== Etymology ==
The name "Solara" has its roots in the ancient [[Solra|Elder Tongue]], where it was originally written as 𐍖𐰇𐰴𐰤 (pronounced /ˈsolra/). The name is composed of two elements:
* '''Sol''' (𐍖𐰇) - Meaning "sun" or "radiance," derived from the proto-Solaran root *sōl-, which also gave rise to the modern Solaran word for sun (sol) and the religious concept of [[Sonism|Son]] (the sun deity).
* '''Ara''' (𐰴𐰤) - Meaning "land," "realm," or "domain," from the proto-Solaran root *ar-, which evolved into the modern Solaran word for land (ara).
The combination "Solara" thus translates to "Land of the Sun" or "Sun Realm," reflecting both the nation's geographical position in the southern regions of Avant and its deep cultural connection to solar worship. This etymology is particularly significant as it:
* Reflects the nation's founding principles of enlightenment and divine guidance * Symbolizes the unity of the three original kingdoms under a single solar banner * Maintains continuity with the ancient [[Solra|Elder Tongue]] used in religious and ceremonial contexts * Embodies the nation's identity as a beacon of civilization and progress
The name was officially adopted during the [[Solaran War of Unification]] in 1538, when General Marcus Solaris united the [[Grand Duchy of Solan]], [[Kingdom of Congrave]], and conquered territories of the [[Kingdom of Albion]]. The choice of name was deliberate, symbolizing not just the unification of territories but also the establishment of a new era under the guidance of the sun deity.
In modern [[Solaran Language|Solaran]], the name is pronounced /soˈlaːra/, with the stress on the second syllable, a development from the original Elder Tongue pronunciation that occurred during the language's evolution in the 16th century.
== History ==
=== Early Years (1538-1900) === The foundation of modern Solara was forged in the crucible of the [[Solaran War of Unification]], a transformative period that reshaped the southern region of Avant. Under the leadership of General Marcus Solaris, the scattered territories of the [[Grand Duchy of Solan]], [[Kingdom of Congrave]], and [[Kingdom of Albion]] were united through a series of brilliant military campaigns known as the [[Seven Years' March]]. The decisive [[Battle of the Three Crowns]] in 1538 marked the turning point of the unification, where General Solaris achieved a stunning victory over the combined armies of Albion and rebel Congrave forces. This victory was followed by the [[Siege of Fort Luminara]] in 1539, a grueling six-month campaign that secured Solara's northern borders and demonstrated the resilience of the newly formed nation.
The [[Treaty of Eternal Light]] in 1540 established Solara's initial borders and governmental structure, creating a framework that would guide the nation's development for centuries. This treaty not only formalized the unification but also established the principles of solar worship as the foundation of the new state. The subsequent decades saw the emergence of the modern Solaran navy under Admiral James Horizon during the [[Great Naval Reform]] (1545-1550), which established Solara's maritime traditions and capabilities. This period witnessed the construction of the first modern shipyards and the development of specialized naval tactics that would become hallmarks of Solaran military doctrine.
The [[First Industrial Revolution]] (1550-1600) marked a significant turning point in Solara's development, as the nation focused its industrial capacity on military production and technological advancement. This period saw the establishment of the first modern shipyards, armories, and military research facilities that would become the foundation of Solara's industrial might. The [[Arctic Expansion Campaign]] (1600-1650) further solidified Solara's position, as the nation systematically colonized the southern ice sheets, establishing strategic outposts and resource extraction facilities that would prove crucial in later conflicts.
The 17th century saw the development of Solara's unique military culture, with the establishment of the [[Solaran Military Academy]] in 1655 and the codification of the [[Ranger's Creed]] in 1672. These institutions laid the groundwork for Solara's elite military forces and established the principles of honor, duty, and sacrifice that would define Solaran military tradition. The [[Great Northern Campaign]] (1680-1690) focused on establishing a comprehensive coastal defense network, with fortified positions and naval bases strategically placed around the island's perimeter. This was complemented by the [[Southern Defense Initiative]] (1695-1705), which established a network of fortifications and observation posts along the southern ice sheets.
The 18th century witnessed the rise of Solara as a major naval power, with the [[Naval Expansion Act]] of 1720 leading to the construction of a formidable fleet. The [[Arctic Warrior Program]] (1730-1740) developed specialized training for operations in extreme cold conditions, while the [[Southern Resistance Doctrine]] (1750-1760) established tactics for guerrilla warfare in arctic conditions. These developments proved crucial during the [[Coastal Defense Campaigns]] (1770-1780), where Solara successfully repelled multiple naval incursions and maintained its territorial integrity.
The 19th century saw Solara's transformation into an industrial powerhouse, with the [[Second Industrial Revolution]] (1800-1850) bringing about significant technological advancements. The [[Military Modernization Act]] of 1820 established the framework for a professional standing army, while the [[Naval Supremacy Program]] (1830-1840) ensured Solara's dominance in regional waters. The [[Arctic Research Initiative]] (1850-1860) led to breakthroughs in cold-weather technology and survival techniques, while the [[Southern Defense Network]] (1870-1880) created a comprehensive system of fortifications and early warning stations.

==== Early 20th Century Reforms (1900-1920) ==== The dawn of the 20th century marked a period of significant military transformation for Solara. The [[Southern Defense Program]] (1900-1910) revolutionized the nation's coastal fortifications, establishing a network of modern naval bases and coastal artillery positions. This period also saw the development of specialized arctic warfare capabilities, as Solara prepared to defend its southern territories against potential threats.
The [[Southern Resistance Program]] (1910-1920) represented a revolutionary approach to military training and doctrine. Recognizing the strategic importance of the southern territories, Solara developed specialized training programs focused on survival and guerrilla warfare in extreme arctic conditions. This program trained elite units in the art of asymmetric warfare, teaching them to operate behind enemy lines and maintain resistance operations even when cut off from supply lines. The program's graduates formed the core of what would later become the [[95th Ranger Regiment]], developing tactics that would prove crucial in future conflicts.
==== Vesperan Naval Conflicts (1920-1930) ==== The 1920s marked a critical period in Solara's military history as the nation found itself confronting the overwhelming might of the [[Vesperan Empire]], the undisputed global superpower that controlled nearly thirty percent of the world's territory. Initial skirmishes with the Vesperan Navy in 1921-1922 revealed the stark reality of Solara's position against the world's dominant military force, prompting an urgent and comprehensive naval modernization program. The [[Battle of the Southern Passage]] (1923) demonstrated the effectiveness of Solara's new naval tactics, as the Solaran fleet successfully repelled a Vesperan task force attempting to establish a presence in southern waters, marking one of the few instances where a smaller power managed to resist Vesperan expansion.
The [[Naval Reform Act of 1924]] initiated a massive expansion of Solara's naval capabilities, focusing on the development of advanced naval tactics and doctrine. The modernization of the fleet with new ship designs became a top priority, as did the enhancement of naval aviation capabilities. The establishment of specialized naval training facilities across the nation ensured that the Solaran Navy would maintain its edge in both conventional and arctic warfare scenarios, despite facing the world's most powerful navy.
These reforms bore fruit in the [[Great Naval Campaign of 1927]], where Solara achieved a series of remarkable victories against the Vesperan Navy. The [[Battle of the Ice Floes]] (1927) became a defining moment in Solaran naval history, as the newly modernized fleet demonstrated its superiority in arctic conditions against the Vesperan forces. The campaign culminated in the [[Treaty of Maritime Peace]] (1928), which established clear boundaries and protocols for naval operations in the region, marking a rare diplomatic achievement against the global superpower.
==== Military Modernization (1930-1937) ==== The success of the naval reforms led to a comprehensive review of Solara's entire military structure. The [[Military Reform Period]] (1930-1937) saw the complete reorganization of Solara's armed forces, with particular emphasis on the integration of naval and ground forces operations. The development of specialized arctic warfare units became a cornerstone of military strategy, while the enhancement of special operations capabilities ensured Solara's ability to conduct complex operations in extreme conditions. The modernization of military infrastructure across the nation supported these new capabilities, creating a more robust and flexible defense network.
This period also saw the establishment of the [[Solaran Naval Academy]] (1932) and the [[Arctic Warfare Training Center]] (1934), institutions that would become cornerstones of Solara's military excellence. The [[Military Modernization Act]] of 1935 formalized these changes, creating a more flexible and responsive military structure capable of operating effectively in both conventional and asymmetric warfare scenarios. These reforms would prove crucial in the coming global conflict, as Solara's military demonstrated its ability to adapt to changing strategic circumstances and maintain its position as a leading military power.
==== Avant Great War (1937-1949) ==== Solara played a crucial role in the [[Avant Great War]] as a leading member of the United Alignment of Nations. The conflict, which lasted from 1937 to 1949, was the deadliest in history with 105-128 million fatalities globally. For detailed information about the war, see [[Avant Great War]].
==== Post-War Development (1949-1989) ==== The aftermath of the Great War saw Solara emerge as a global superpower, though significantly weakened by the conflict. The nation's recovery and subsequent rise to prominence was marked by several distinct phases of development, each contributing to Solara's eventual position as a leading military and technological power.
The [[Industrial Recovery Program]] (1949-1959) represented the first phase of Solara's post-war reconstruction. This decade-long initiative focused on rebuilding the nation's devastated infrastructure while simultaneously expanding industrial capacity. The program saw the construction of new shipyards in Congrave and Frostfell, the establishment of advanced manufacturing facilities in Suncrown, and the modernization of transportation networks across the nation. The private military sector flourished during this period, with [[SolarTech Aerospace Corporation]] and [[Luminex Weapons Systems]] emerging as the dominant manufacturers, supported by hundreds of smaller specialized defense contractors. These companies would become the backbone of Solara's military-industrial complex, developing new technologies and production methods that would shape the nation's future capabilities.
The [[Military Modernization]] period (1960-1970) integrated the hard-won lessons of the Great War into Solara's military doctrine. This era witnessed the complete overhaul of the Solaran Armed Forces, with particular emphasis on missile technology and naval power. The [[Ballistic Missile Program]] (1960-1965) established Solara's medium-range missile capabilities, though further development of these weapons systems was not pursued. The [[Naval Expansion Initiative]] (1965-1970) saw the construction of a new generation of warships, including the revolutionary [[w:Nimitz-class aircraft carrier|Nimitz-class]] aircraft carriers and [[w:Ohio-class submarine|Ohio-class]] nuclear submarines. These vessels would form the core of Solara's blue-water navy, ensuring the nation's ability to project power across the southern oceans.
The [[Technological Revolution]] (1970-1980) marked a period of unprecedented advancement in military technology and weapons systems. Research facilities across Solara worked tirelessly to develop new technologies, with particular focus on: * Advanced propulsion systems for naval vessels * Next-generation fighter aircraft * Precision-guided munitions * Electronic warfare capabilities * Space-based surveillance and communication systems
The [[Defense Initiative]] (1980-1989) focused on strengthening Solara's defensive capabilities through a comprehensive modernization of all military branches. The [[Air Defense Modernization Program]] (1980-1984) introduced new surface-to-air missile systems and advanced radar networks, while the [[Naval Fleet Expansion]] (1985-1989) saw the construction of additional carrier groups and amphibious assault ships. The [[Ground Forces Modernization]] (1980-1989) transformed Solara's army into a highly mobile, technologically advanced force, with new armored vehicles, artillery systems, and infantry equipment.
Throughout this period, Solara's military-industrial complex grew exponentially, with [[SolarTech Aerospace Corporation]] and [[Luminex Weapons Systems]] emerging as the world's leading manufacturers of military equipment. These corporations produced everything from small arms to aircraft carriers, supported by a vast network of specialized subcontractors and research facilities. The nation's research and development capabilities were further enhanced by private sector initiatives, which focused on developing next-generation weapons systems and military technologies.
The final years of this period (1985-1989) saw Solara basking in its status as a global superpower, having achieved unprecedented military and economic dominance. The nation's leadership and population grew increasingly confident, even arrogant, in their position of privilege and power. The [[Military Modernization Act]] of 1987 was less about preparing for potential conflicts and more about maintaining Solara's position at the pinnacle of global military power. By the end of 1989, Solara had fully embraced its role as a dominant superpower, with its citizens enjoying the benefits of military supremacy and economic prosperity.

The [[Solaran Liberty Front]] (SLF) occupies the political center, advocating for individual freedoms and market liberalization while promoting diplomatic solutions to international conflicts. The left-wing [[Solaran People's Party]] (SPP) focuses on workers' rights and social equality, supporting increased public spending on education and healthcare. The [[Solaran Green Party]] (SGP) emphasizes environmental protection and sustainable development, advocating for renewable energy and conservation. The [[Future Solara Movement]] (FSM) promotes technological innovation and modernization, supporting education reform and digital transformation.
The nation has developed efficient resource management and recycling systems to maintain industrial self-sufficiency where possible, though some raw materials must be imported. The national currency, the Solari, is managed by the Solaran Central Bank, ensuring economic stability and growth.

According to the 2010 census, Solara has a population of 164 million people. The population is primarily urban, with over 75% of citizens living in major cities. The capital region of Congrave forms the largest metropolitan area with approximately 15 million inhabitants.
